review: Staff were friendly, rooms were comfortable and clean. Great location!

Eugenio was exceptionally kind, accommodating, and friendly. He responded to all our questions and requests via WhatsApp with lightning-fast speed—even leaving the beach on the Sunday we arrived to return to the B&B and assist us personally. Overall, staying at B&B Casa Benvenuto was a pleasure, and the town of Diamante was absolutely wonderful. I highly recommend this B&B to anyone looking for a comfortable, welcoming place to stay that won’t break the bank. Everything was positive
Comfortable clean and great location Nothing
Peaceful and beautiful location with stunning view of the sea. My family and I were very happy. There's nothing I would change, perhaps add a choice of a bar fridge in the room

Host was phenomenal. Kind and very helpful. Breakfast every morning and a little kitchen in common area stocked with cold water when we returned from really hot days. Location was was minutes from everything we wanted to see. Convenient too to have a little bistro right downstairs for days that were too hot to walk anywhere for a snack or light lunch. If you are a light sleeper, be aware that you will hear train noises due to the convenient location. This does not bother me as location and friendly help will supersede noise level.
Brand new rooms with a nice service and close to everything. Definitely one of the best places I have found in Booking.com
Everything was perfect. Nothing

The place had an amazing atmosphere the breakfast was amazing. We showed up late and the host was very welcoming. The room and reception was clean and tidy. The bed creaked a bit more than I would have appreciated.

The location was very convenient - near the train station entrance, restaurant and swimming. The host was very friendly and helpful. When we were there it was very hot and there was no air conditioning so we had to keep the windows open. This was a problem as it was very noisy in the street below especially early in the morning.

Attractive historic town, good location close to autoroute, restaurant on site No A/C, bus tour of noisy Chinese guests stayed up late and rose early, the veal cutlet was almost inedible it was so tough
Lots of space, host was quick to help and return emails, great location Took us a minute to figure out showers

Andrea was a fabulous host, she provided a list of local restaurants which helped us navigate through the city and each and every one on that list were exceptional. The bed was very comfortable, the mini fridge was quite spacious and the room was big equipped with it's own AC unit. Very well located at a 5 minutes walk from most attractions in the city center. The shower head and the drain were clogged so washing ourselves wasn't an ideal experience. Wi-Fi was quite slow at some instances. We didn't get a view of the bridge but of a church (not that it wasn't pretty but was expecting to get to see the bridge from our room.) It wasn't a full deep daily housecleaning but rather a quick superficial one (the bed sheets were not changed).

The hotel location Is perfect. Walking distance of eveything. Clean and modern room. The room are a bit small for 3 people. There is no one at the front desk. The communication with the staff are all by text. However very responsive if something is needed.
Very nice accommodation, clean, parking close by, beautiful roof top deck, on the edge of the old town. If you have difficulty with stairs it probably isn't for you.

Staff was very friendly, property was nice, rooms were spacious and had a great view of the lake. The car park location was a bit inconvenient but it was ok. The town's proximity to Como was good as well. The air conditioning in the room was terrible. It was extremely hot during our stay and the room would not get cold. The hotel also did not have any fans, which would have helped immensely.

Such a beautiful location, very relaxing, wonderful breakfasts and dinners. The staff were all very friendly and helpful, and Giulio and Diego went above and beyond in helping us. Possibly the best lodgings we have ever stayed at, wouldn't hesitate to come back again. The road to drive up can prove a little challenging, but we found it quite entertaining actually.

Nicola met us at the property. We arrived late, and he was very accommodating. We were met with a cozy, comfortable and clean apartment with AC. It was super hot when we went, so we are truly grateful for the AC. The apartment is a 10-minute walk from the Rialto Bridge. It's really close to pretty much everything. Nicola gave very clear instructions on how to get to the property from the boat launch. It felt very safe, and the streets are well lit. The apartment had everything we needed except for a paper towel. It more than exceeded our expectations, and we truly loved our stay. I also loved the fact that we were able to store our bags after check-out. The cleaners were very kind and accommodating. You can tell they work hard. I wouldn't change a thing. Maybe just have a paper towel on site would be great.
The host was extremely kind and accommodating. The apartment is closer to the main attractions and stores and comes with all of the necessary amenities.

Everything was perfect! The check-in process was flawless, and Pierpaolo took the time to show us all of the amenities and explain everything carefully. The location of the house is great (we also found parking on a street close by) it's a few mins away from the historical center, and there are a ton of restaurant options around. The bedrooms are super comfortable, the house is spotless, and the terrace is the cherry on top! The bathroom was super well equipped (with shampoo, q tips, toothpaste, shower gel, etc. - which is a huge plus) and so was the kitchen. A huge thank you to Pierpaolo for creating a little peaceful oasis in Ostuni and making our stay wonderful.
We used our breakfast.Stefani...is a angel...every morning she didi For us coffee...she is such nice person... Frogs outside the room. Very noisy at night...ha ha ha ...free concert

We're a simple family! We don't need much to be satisfied! The room is clean . The location is great, in walking distance of the city centre. We are really impressed with very polite and pleasant staff! 10 out of 10! All recommendations!
The hotel was very clean and comfortable. The water bus and taxi station to get to the airport were right beside the hotel. The hotel is walking distance to the city center, shops, and restaurants.
Great location. Rosario was an ideal host.

The room room was clean. The bathroom had bo dide, and the balcony was not a balcony but there was a hot water tank and 3 air-conditioning units. I will ask for compensation. The bathroom had no dide, and the balcony was not a balcony but there a storage area there was a hot water tank and 2 air-conditioning units. I will ask for compensation. I paid for a balcony.
Outdoor patio. Location Bathroom small, room small.

The location was excellent...a short walk from the archeological park, and the parking was easy and always available inside the gated courtyard of the apartment. The apartment was very nice, very spavious, modern in a new building, with nice terraces and surrounded by lush gardens and trees. The owner, Salvo, was OK to deal with...not especially helpful. However, his associate, Lucia, lives on a lower level and she was extremely welcoming, responsive, and helpful, and fun to speak with. She gave us lemons from one of the trees. She is also a talented artist with a studio on the main level...I recommend that you stop in to her studio to see her work. Kitchen was well equipped, and the washing machine was great to have. Not an issue for us on this trip, but this apartment is up some flights of stairs. It wouldn't be suitable for people with mobility issues.

It is a good location and it is confortable and resourceful place. The fridge seal is broken so the moisture was all over the food. At the moment of receiving the keys at the front desk a person who works at the hotel passed by pushing and giving instruction to us to move without taking consideration about the small space between door, desk and the exterior. She could be more gentle.
Workers were very kind and helpful Room was polished and clean We didn’t have any noise at night Location was perfect
Spacious well equipped bathroom, comfy beds, very helpful staff.
The staff are friendly and very helpful. The lady at the front desk and the restaurant staff. Nothing
Location, staff, the garden (!)
Great place to stay at. Ran by a great couple. They provided us food despite us checking early (well before breakfast time).
Staff was very friendly and helpful! Room was large and comfortable.

Breakfast was amazing, the location was right by the river with direct access to the ferry. amazing location the staff emailed us only 5 days prior to our checkin , stating that they have "overbooked" and we would have to move to hotel sole which is their sister hotel. We had already booked this accommodation 6 months in advance along with our friends. We were upset that they did not inform us of this until a couple days prior. this is bad communication from the hotel staff and we were disappointed especially when we had booked this hotel way in advance.

Loved the apartment! Everything we needed for a comfortable stay. Beautiful patio across from the sea. Easy to walk everywhere for anything needed and right across from the train station if you’re commuting from anywhere. Matteo was a very accommodating host! Would definitely book this apartment again! Nothing

Close to the airport which made leaving for an early flight easy. Plus the shuttle was available at 3am. Stayed overnight for the purpose of catching an early flight home. Was a bit loud from others staying in the b&b, but not necessarily the fault of the owner. Made it hard to get sleep early, as people were coming and going through the night units around 1am. Otherwise no other issues.

The location is great, there is a lot of space, the laundry machine worked well, and the bed was comfortable. The a/c was critical as it was very hot. The list of recommendations is so helpful, and we would definitely stay here again!! Contact through Whatsapp instead of Booking meant we didn't see the communications until we arrived, but once we called the number the host was very helpful and got us set up right away.

Nice and clean room, balcony with a view of street and the bay Tasty breakfast offers various choices Easy check-in Free parking Street was noisy It's hard to walk up and down the street due to traffic

Location was excellent close to the beach and the boardwalk filled with great restaurants and shops and a minute to the historic centre. Host was awesome. Kitchen was great and well furnished. Beds were comfortable and multiple ac units on site to keep the place cool. The unit could use more comfortable seating, like an extra couch and maybe cushioned chairs on the patio? We loved our stay but these improvements would have made it a 10 instead of a 9. Beach towels on site would have been good to have as well. Giuseppe was amazing! Great host 😀
Wonderful location, super staff!
Central location Cleaning staff did not replenish toiletries. Had to ask for toilet paper every day.
The location, the terrace, the coffee area The thin walls and noise from people in corridors. An umbrella on the terrace would be amazing

We had a wonderful stay! The location is fantastic, just a short walk to all the main attractions, yet tucked away enough to offer quiet. Most attractions are within 5 minutes on foot, and even the Arena is only about a 10-minute walk. The room was comfortable and well-kept, with a cozy atmosphere. While the bathroom was on the smaller side, it was clean and functional. Breakfast was lovely with a good variety, and the highlight of our stay was the staff; everyone was incredibly friendly and helpful, especially Carla! Making us feel truly welcome. Highly recommended for anyone looking for a quiet, well-located place with genuine Veronese hospitality. Bathroom very small, but it goes with the architecture of the building.
Great location. Clean large room. Building has some issues (ie door handles falling off) but otherwise it is great! We really enjoyed being close to everything including the metro.

The front desk staff were really friendly and helpful with check-in and showing me around. The dorm I stayed in was clean and comfortable and they even made my bed for me the next day when I was out site-seeing! Also, the kitchen was full of complimentary snacks and drinks. It was amazing!

La Fattoria di Tirrenia was perfect for our stay. The apartment we stayed in was spacious and clean. There was a large kitchen with a washer which was very helpful! The kids loved the pool and playground. I would definitely stay here again! Only a minor thing - I wish the pool was open later into the evening. My son was attending a camp and did not return to the resort until later in the evening. He was disappointed to miss the pool hours. Other than that, no complaints!
Easy check in, good location kitchen allowed for basic cooking. Written recycling instructions and penalties were a bit confusing. Host seemed more casual about it than what was written.
Location convenient, it was close to the city and reasonable transportation. They also has good free parking space. Very old building and beds were not comfortable, still reasonably priced.
Good value for money. Clean, helpful staff. AC was good (centrally controlled but temp was appropriate). Great location. Close to everything but away from the overly touristy areas.

If you want to experience true warmth, comfort, and heartfelt hospitality, this is the place to stay. Everything here is created with so much love and care — from the smallest details in the interior to the genuine attention of the hosts. A very special thank you to Lucia for her incredible help — she kindly picked us up from the station and brought us back, which was such a blessing as we didn’t have a car and it turned out taxis in Montepulciano are quite hard to find. We stayed for only a couple of days, but it felt like we were welcomed as old friends. The coziness, cleanliness, breathtaking views, and the wonderful energy of this home made our stay truly unforgettable. When we left, we felt a little sadness in our hearts because we had grown so fond of this place and the amazing people who created it. We truly hope to return one day!
The entire apartment and all the facilities. We didn't miss anything.
Great location, easy to locate upon arrival at the train station. Staff were friendly and helpful. The bed was so comfortable and everything was very clean!
Beautiful view!

The host Riccardo is very friendly and gave us lots of tips on visiting the attractions of the Amalfi region and Pompeii, parking, busing, restaurants, etc. The apartment is beautiful, spacious, bright and has all amenities needed in a vacation. There is a salumeria right across the street, with good samples of local food at very reasonable prices and a grocery store and restaurants in close range as well. A bus to Salerno leaves minutes from there. Cava the tirreni gives a good idea what a town in this area feels like without the swarms of tourists that you meet on the Amalfi Coast or Capri.
Location was amazing! Also Maria was an amazing host - let us in to our room at 6am following a long bus ride. We had such an amazing time in Florence.

The hotel was beautiful and in a PERFECT location. The waterbus taxi is located outside the front gates. The courtyard is lovely and away from the main street so it's quiet and a nice area to have a morning coffee or evening drink. The room was gorgeous with a large bed and very spacious (including a large bathroom). The housekeeping was quick and kept the room fresh every day. The breakfast included is a really nice selection and varied, including pancakes, eggs, meats, pastries and fresh fruit and vegetables. The staff were very friendly and the view outside the front door on the dock is spectacular. I would highly recommend this hotel for anyone visiting Venice. Thank you for making our honeymoon perfect! Nothing. Loved the hotel and our stay!
Large space considering that in Rome, most spaces are smaller. Pillows were too soft/flat, but a minor detail in the over all stay.

The location was fantastic. Just steps away from the center. Going outside to get to the bedrooms. There was a downpour of rain and the steps got slippery so going from one floor to another in that was difficult especially since I was injured.

The owners will host you to show you around and to give you every advices you need to know. They know the area very well so you can trust their recommandation. Wifi is not working very well but who needs wifi when you are in the mountains.. It's a really high standard, you can feel home for few days and the bed was very comfortable. Thank you and good job for your hard work 🌞

Such a convenient location, literally across the street from the main train station in Milan, made travelling with our luggage extremely easy. Near a million scooters and bikes which made exploring very easy and the complimentary breakfast is brought straight to your room so you can eat in bed! Room is standard, cozy and clean. Very nice bathroom, and all the lighting and air conditioning, etc, are eco friendly and turn off when you leave – we love a eco-friendly hotel that actually cares!!! Hotel doesn't have a pool, only downside lol!

Great location near both train stations, Pompeii and the Sanctuary. Fabulous views from the balconies. Host was friendly and helpful. Large room. Lots of noise from the streets, hot water was inconsistant

A truly wonderful and peaceful place — I enjoyed every moment of my stay! Thank you to the owner for personally meeting us and showing us the apartments. He was very kind and welcoming, which made us feel right at home from the start. The location is perfect: calm and surrounded by fresh air and greenery — an ideal spot to relax after the busy pace of cities like Venice and Trieste. The house itself is amazing, built with beautiful brick and wood, creating a unique and cozy atmosphere. The bedrooms were full of their own character, and the kitchen was absolutely one-of-a-kind. Breakfast was delicious, and everything was prepared with care. I truly enjoyed the experience 100% and would love to return again. Nothing extra to add, we had everything we needed)
Absolutely wonderful. The comfort, the cleanliness, the location, and above all the host.

The location was great. We were able to get our room early. Overall the hostel was clean. Incredibly noisy. We could hear people yelling in the street until sunrise, and because there was no curfew, people were loud in the hallway until dawn everyday. Our room was street facing and we were told it's better if the room is courtyard facing since there is a 11 pm curfew for the bar. Beds were uncomfortable and the private room was really small. We barely had space to move around the bed. There was no safe, phone, or chair in our room and the AC wasn't making a big difference considering how hot it was outside. Breakfast and laundry are really expensive for a hostel and we preferred to eat outside. It is a massive hostel so we saw people lining up for a long time to check in, despite the ticketing system.

The condo was very spacious for our family of 4it was clean and had all the amenities we needed during our stay. The location was close to restaurants, ice cream shop and small grocery store which had fresh bread every morning. The condo is only 5 min away from a beautiful beach.

We had a wonderful stay. The hosts were friendly and welcoming, the bed was comfortable, and the breakfast was amazing with lots of options. They even had lactose-free milk, which was perfect for my morning coffee.
Nice clean large room. Excellent outdoor grounds, plenty of free parking Restaurant in the hotel was a bit pricey with average food. Pool was closed due to a wedding.
Excellent location near main train station, helpful staff, good breakfast

The location and the our rooms were very clean. our host was extremely helpful in letting us drop off our bags early. being close to the historic district was a bonus. there was nothing to complain about.

It was a great experience, staying at this apartment. Big, clean, well equipped, beautifully designed. Great location, comfortable bed, parking garage with pay. We had a good time on our vacation in Florence and stay at Celeste's House. Thank you!

In a rural setting at the foot of the supramonte mountains. A majestic scenery.. easy to get to Cala Ganone. Free parking at the roundabout coming down the mountain into Cala Ganone.with a free shuttle to the port. The layout of the hotel is very gorgeous. We had a. Amazing breakfast. We had dinner at the hotel restaurant. We had Antonio's home made pasta..Dinner options at Dorgali seem limited. Lots of pizzerias. Just wonderful experience. 😊
The breakfast was great with many options, we appreciated that. The rooms were large and newly renovated The location was is in an industrial area

Very easy to check in, and wonderful responsive hosts. Great location, close to the train station. Apartment is spacious and has everything you need for a short stay (kitchen, washing machine, air conditioning). The windows could use some blackout blinds or curtains, as there's lots of light that comes in so the room isn't very dark for sleeping.
It's nice clean property. Room was good, clean. Washroom up to the maerk . The reception gave me a warm welcome. Mr. Mimmo was very helpful. The area is near to train station. I didn't like the area
Rocca Lorenizo is a gem run by friendly and responsive owners who truly care about aesthetic quality and the quality of their guests' stay.

Lovely apartment in the centre of Bari which was perfect for our family of 3. Great spot that is close to everything so a great place to explore the city. The apartment is very clean and well maintained and has everything one would need and more. The host was super helpful and accommodating and helped us get a taxi to the airport and answered questions during our stay.
For anyone who doesn't eat pork, or seafood, menu options were quite limited to the vegetarian option, but what was provided as vegetarian was delicious.

Location was amazing, easy walk to everything. Beautiful space, sorry comfortable. Some hiccups in the AC unit when we first checked in but property manager was super responsive even though it was after hours. Gianmarco was very helpful and flexible in trying to resolve the situation for us, great experience! The fruits at breakfast were over ripe, not edible at all 😅 It would be really nice if fresh fruits could be served.

Clean, well-equipped, and stocked with everything we needed for a two-day stay. Secure parking available at extra cost. Great value for money! Check-in was inconvenient. keys had to be collected from an office in the mall near the building, and our early check-in request was withdrawn, leaving my family waiting in the car.
Warm welcome. Good food. Comfortable accommodation. Museum hotel that is fun to be in! Nothing.

The rooftop garden was beautiful, staff was helpful and kind and we enjoyed the free breakfast. Great location if you want to be in the centre. The bed and sheets were extremely uncomfortable. We didn't sleep well here.

The bnb is in a great location, just a short walk outside the city centre. It was quite a hot weekend and the air conditioning wasn't working. We asked for the remote to turn the unit on, but it did not work. The beds were very uncomfortable as well.
Very clean and recently redecorated. Room was not big but very comfortable! Place to put toiletries in bathroom.

Very close to Malpensa Airport and they have a shuttle going back and forth (though it's not free) The floor we were on had construction going on, was dusty, and had an odd smell. The room was pretty beat up and super dated, the pillows were a joke, the elevator smelled very funky, the whole place just looked very shoddy and our one night there was very uncomfortable.

Everything was exceptional 👌 kids friendly, quiet and beautiful. The family who runs the place is so polite and kind and always welcoming 🙏 😊 I loved staying there and I would go back without doubt ✔️🇮🇹🇨🇦🇵🇹
Cleanliness, easy check in, amazing room and host. Would definitely stay again. Check out time would be ideal at 11am not 10am
The manager was so friendly... She was explaining everything.. places of interest so friendly person Space

Everything! Our room was delightful- Fabio's breakfasts were always something different and special. Lara was a great host and both were full of information and recommendations. Housekeeping ladies were lovely. It was a very relaxing time and felt like being welcomed into someone's home. Absolutely nothing negative to say!

Breakfast was absolutely lovely with a secret garden in the back. The room was comfortable and spacious and the staff couldn't be more lovely. The location is a little way from the old heart of the city.

The facilities, hospitality and location were perfect! The staff went above and beyond to welcome us and the resort was absolutely stunning! The breakfast prepared were pastries by our host and they were delicious, we also ate at the restaurant in house and the ambiance and food made for an unforgettable stay!

Amazing experience, my whole family loved it! I really liked the custom made solid wood furniture, my kids found the blankets especially soft. WiFi speed was around 7 Mbits/s. Charming scenery around (well, it's up in the mountains, and driving there may not seem easy, if you are used to wide straight roads ;) Super nice hosts, they came to show us everything on the property, explained where to find good food and where to hike in the area, and even treated us with some local honey, that was delicious!
The pool was really nice! Because it was really hot out. The beds were really old and used

Wonderful apartment hotel on Lake Garda. Pool is perfect and the bar service is great for an afternoon snack. We actually ended up extending our planned stay by 1 night. Very central next to the pier for dinner with a view and faces west for the nicest sunsets everyday evening. Rooms are quite warm, limited AC. Just need to refresh in the pool :)

The place was amazing, calming, and can make you feel the real meaning of serenity. And the staff jullian. He's an angel. Kindness overload, very accommodating. We'll definitely come back to that place.

Excellent location and staff. Good amenities and rooms are fine. Staff is really friendly and helpful, especially Brigitte at the front desk was very helpful. The breakfast was very good. I booked 6 nights suit, the furniture seemed a bit old considering the standards and the price paid.
The staff , the decor, the situation Nothing

The apartment was clean, comfortable. Bathroom was lovely and updated, original lighting fixtures and wall decor. Valentina was helpful with our questions. A few things to make the stay better for us would have been to have little things available in the apartment: wine glasses & opener, extra garbage bags, cold water bottles and seasonings for cooking? Having traveled across Sicily and stays in multiple airbnb's, its the attention to details that make the best stays memorable

We booked a one night stay at MiriAle so we wouldn't have to rush the next morning for our flight. It was an amazing end to our family vacation! We were a family of 7, so we had two apartments, which were both very clean, fully stocked, and comfortable. Fabio and his wife own the property and were wonderful hosts! Fabio drives a taxi and offered to help us around the city on our last day since we had to bring back our car. He drove us around when needed and gave us a complimentary tour of some of the hidden gems of Rome. Our family absolutely loved our stay and will definitely be back the next time we're in Rome. Grazie Fabio per la vostro ospitalità! Nothing the property and hosts are wonderful.

Well, where to start, it was all so good? The reception from Mama Ivana and Papa Gio was magnificent. (Over 60 years of marriage) Also, Lavigno (spelling) was very helpful prior to my arrival and upon arrival. Excellent recommendations for culinary adventures were provided. De Ricci winery - a wonderful visit to the wine cellar in town followed by lunch at the vineyard. Osteria Aquacheta for wonderful bifstecca, what a highlight. Reservations for both are required. Luciano, the barber, provided wonderful shaves with his 75 years of experience. La Botegga del Nobile for wonderful wine tasting and dining experience provided by Lorenzo. The accommodation is well appointed and very well kept. This is the only place that I will stay in Montepulciano!
Location No tv in family room. Previous renters broke it and was not replaced. I asked for certain things that were missing and got no reply. Not great communication. Too bad.
Idk Idk
The location was perfect and the restaurant beside was a great spot to eat. Needed more than just a sheet on the bed.. would have liked a blanket as well. A dish towel to do dishes, or wipe hands.

The room was OK, if your looking to just sleep here. There's no furniture like a table and chair. So basically you just sit on the bed. Or lay down. I've rented plenty of rooms on Airbnb, trivalgo, booking.com..etc. etc...For this rental... i had a terrible time checking in. There is no one there. I didn't know I had to communicate with WHATSAPP. The guy texted me on Booking.com and said all the checkin info was sent through WHATSAPP....WHY NOT JUST SEND IT THROUGH BOOKING.COM COMMUNNICATION.???..he texted me to say it was sent to WhatsApp... could have just sent me the info... at this point, I was frustrated.. so i had to download the app when I got there,.... luckily, my data was just turned on at the airport and was able to download the App.. however.. I still haven't received any instructions one hour later. I called the guy, and he wouldn't answer. I had a nice lady in the building call him twice to let him know I was there waiting... It seemed odd that I called him 1 min before but didn't answer..Each tike she made a call, he answered her right away.... I waited about an hour and a half outside..... it was to the point I thought I got ripped off and scammed. Finally, someone showed up with keys and a code to get in.. Terrible communication. Other than that, the room is ok. It's close to Vatican, yes, but the Vatican entrance is on the other side. About a half-hour walk. The San Pietro train station is a 2 minute walk, costs $2 to go to the Roma Termini.

There was no bottled water, and no breakfast provided. The location was very inconvenient, but it was quiet, peaceful, and offered a beautiful view. It would have been even better if the mosquito problem in the backyard could be addressed. My son's legs were badly bitten during our stay and remained swollen for several days—we had to buy a lot of medicine to treat them.

We stayed two nights in the Cipresso apartment and one night in the Aloro. Both were spacious, beautifully maintained, and spotlessly clean. The complimentary drinks and snacks were a thoughtful touch—especially handy as supermarkets aren’t the easiest to find nearby. The central location was perfect, with most major attractions, restaurants, cafés, and shopping just a 10–15 minute walk away. The concierge service was outstanding—attentive, helpful, and truly charming. Overall, a wonderful stay in a beautiful setting No bathtub, for the size of the apartment bathrooms are on the smaller side.
Wonderful breakfast, nice environment. It was a bit difficult to find the hotel; better signage would be an improvement.
good clean and bright, sufficient food
Super comfy and clean and spacious room Nothing really. It's not smack in old town but also you don't need to be. Great for many many parking options around
We liked everything: beautiful house inside and out, awesome surroundings, very clean and well appointed accommodation, awesome hosts. Would definitely return.
It was all great, nice people, beautiful views. I had no problems.

Location is perfect, you can walk to the main tourist spots in Naples. Also very close to the Toledo metro station. Our room was very clean and silent. Breakfast was excelent: breads, cheeses, prosciuto, pastries, yogurt, granola, eggs, fruits, juices, pies: all you can wish for. Very good price for what you get. Thanks for all the staff, that served us always with a smile, especially Esther: knowledgeble, efficient and caring. Don't be put off by the elevator (the hotel is on the 3rd floor). It is in a beautifully restored pallazo, typical of Naples. Actually it added to the charm of our Naples experience.
Very nice hotel, room was very comfortable. Very nice breakfast. The rooftop lounge was great.

Only one thing to share: this is the BEST hostel I have ever stayed in my whole life. If you're planning to go to Rome, please, choose it. Everything is very close, and place and staff are EXCELLENT! I don't have anything to share. Everything was EXCELLENT. I stayed one week and I had so much fun. I do consider of going back again next summer.
GOOD OCATION , BEAKFAST LIMITED BUT ADEQUATE UNDER RENOVATIONS AT TIME OF STAY
We loved the view and also the decoration. It’s time to change the bed sheets. I was not comfortable to use old sheet.

Right in the centre of old Monopoli, near many restaurants, and close to the sea. The location was amazing. The room was very clean and spacious. The bed was big and comfortable. The host was great at answering messages and giving instructions to access the property.

Alessandro is a great host , very friendly and always available. The room we had ( Palmarola) was amazing Very tastefully decorated and One of the biggest in the area probably Everything was Amazing Breakfast on the terrace with a stunning view Look forward to going back next time we're in Gaeta. Nothing not to like

The hosts were very friendly and accommodating. They cared about our experience, and were helpful giving suggestions for things to do and making dinner suggestions and reservations. The rooms, property and breakfast had everything we could have wanted, and we felt like part of the family. They suggested visiting Villa Reale, Napolean's sister's palace, which was very beautiful. The only thing I could have asked for is an extra pillow. Lucca was not my favorite city, but the hosts gave us great suggestions of other things to do and see outside of the city, which helped to make our stay wonderful.
Location is wonderfully in downtown Reggio Emilia, wifi is fast and allow to remote working.
We loved our stay at Palazzo Charlie. It is very well located and was very comfortable. The hosts, Manon and Charlie are wonderful and looked after us exceptionally well.
Beautiful, well kept grounds. Everything was clean and to a high standard. Staff were friendly and welcoming. Love the breakfast!
No breakfast available. A bit far away from Bellagio centre Garden, Pool area, scenery
Excellent place.

Good location. The hotel from the outside looks nice and updated, Once inside it looks like it hasn't been updated in 50 years. Worn out and old. Had to ask the front desk to turn on the air conditioning. We thought it was broken.

A Wonderful Stay in the Heart of Naples – with a Rooftop View You Won’t Forget! We recently had the pleasure of staying at Napolinn B&B both before and after our Mediterranean cruise—on June 27 and again on July 5—and we could not have been more delighted with our experience. From the moment we arrived, Guiliana, our host, made us feel genuinely welcome. As a couple traveling together, we really appreciated her warmth, personal attention, and helpful recommendations. She gave us fantastic local tips on where to eat and shop, which helped us make the most of our short time in Naples. The location of Napolinn is absolutely ideal—right in the heart of the city, within easy walking distance of Naples’ top attractions, bustling shopping areas, and great restaurants. Whether you’re catching a cruise (like we were) or just exploring the city, you won’t find a more convenient base. Our room was spacious, air-conditioned, and had a very comfortable bed, which was perfect after long travel days. We slept well both nights we stayed. One of the standout features of Napolinn is the rooftop patio—it’s where breakfast is served, and it offers spectacular views of Naples. It’s the perfect place to start your day with a delicious cappuccino, latte, or espresso, alongside fresh croissants and cornetti. Sitting up there in the morning sun, looking out over the rooftops of Naples, was one of our favorite memories of the trip. Be sure to bring your camera—this spot is a hidden gem for photos! A few additional notes for fellow travelers: Elevator access is available, which is a big plus when arriving with luggage. The rooms are quiet, despite the central location—great for a good night’s sleep. Communication with the B&B (especially Guiliana) was easy and clear before and during our stay. Check-in and check-out were smooth and efficient. We would absolutely stay at Napolinn again and wholeheartedly recommend it to anyone visiting Naples. Thank you again, Guiliana.

Just be careful

Andrea was marvelous throughout the stay. We could have done without the car being broken into, but that's no fault of the property of the owners.

Nice room with restaurant next to it Very close to Scopello center
Location was great. Friendly staff, Clean and neat everyday. Vacuuming sound interrupted our sleeping time almost every day around 5:30 am.

Clean and modernly renovated apartment with everything you need for the stay. We enjoyed the kitchen and very good kitchen equipment, because we usually use kitchen a lot during our trips. Very nice and clean bathroom.

We liked everything about our stay. It was comfortable, nice space and so very clean. The staff were exceptional. They were very helpful with information about the city. Highly recommend this place. All wonderful.

Jiacomo at the reception is super nice and helpful. Also thanks to the technicians who helped to turn on the heater in our apartment at 10pm. Food is delicious and room is clean and comfortable. The bed made loud noises with every turning.

Great location, excellent breakfast, very attentive and helpful staff

Salvatore is an incredible host. He has such a nice, and entertaining personality, makes everyone feel happy to be there. Really good breakfast with multiple choices and great variety. For bycycle access to reception it was not apparent that an elevator was the only choice. Some labelling required as the first assumption is to use either of two staircases.

Can't say enough about how wonderful this property is! We spent four nights at Hotel Vecchia Oliviera. The hotel is elegant and traditional, with magnificent views over the valley. Its location near the entrance of the town makes parking easy. This place is fabulous. Close to the beach and in the heart of the old town. Clean and comfy with an amazing rooftop breakfast. The staff is friendly and very helpful. Would definitely stay here again and recommend to any interested guests 👍

Was changed twice for parking. Day prior arrival try to contact me and convince to cancel booking, had that option. And book directly with them to avoid Booking fee.

Great staff, very accommodating and a great place for the money. The room is spacious and the facilities are as advertised.

The fridge freezer are turned off when you arrive so don't bring perishables that require freezing/cooling when you check in. The furniture is not very comfortable so relaxing on the balcony or in the apartment is only sitting upright on hard chairs. The pool is owned and run by a separate company and you are required to wear a swimming cap whenever you are in it so you should bring this, or you have to buy one. The wifi is very weak if you are in an apartment with a sea view... And you definitely want the sea view apartments otherwise the apartments are very close together and a bit claustrophobic.

It was a beautiful room and very clean. The room looked exactly like the photos so we knew exactly what to expect. It was very hot when we stayed in Matera and the air conditioning was struggling to keep up so the room was a bit warm for us. But otherwise we had a wonderful stay!

The host were super nice and receptive. Excellent info given for arrival. AC in both bedroom, wonderful neighbors (Isabelle and Marco), few restaurant walking distance, 5 min walk to beach, 5 min drive to village of Valledoria, bed was comfortable, well equipped apartment. Wi-Fi was slow
The staff was super helpful in providing suggestions and helping book reservations. The view was amazing and the room was beautiful. My stay was perfect I have nothing I did not like.

This was a great place to stay in Rome in a very good, central location right beside Campo di Fiori. We felt like we were living like Romans. I recently stayed at this lovely homestay in Rome and couldn’t have been happier with my experience. If you're anything like me and enjoy winding down your day in peace and quiet, this place is absolutely ideal. It’s tucked away in a calm and quiet neighborhood, just about a 5-minute walk from the Battistini metro station, which made getting around the city incredibly convenient. The home itself felt very cozy and welcoming. While there’s no air conditioning—which is pretty standard for the area—the weather was cool and comfortable during my stay. I did request a fan just for a bit of airflow, and it was provided without any issue. One of the things I really appreciated was having my own private bathroom, even though it’s located separately from the bedroom. It gave me the sense of privacy I was looking for. I also had access to the washing machine, which was super helpful during my trip. Overall, I found this stay to be perfect for what I needed: quiet, comfort, and convenience. I’d definitely recommend it to fellow travelers looking for a peaceful base in Rome.

We had high hopes for this Masseria and had it booked more than 6 months in advance. With its exceptional ratings and the fact that it was quite new and everything looked great on their website and instagram, we expected it to be one of the highlights of our trip. Unfortunately there are a number of issues we encountered which soured our stay and we felt very let down given the price we paid. The biggest and most prevalent issue in our eyes was how open to the public the Masseria is. As a boutique hotel with only 5 luxury rooms, we expected a quiet, intimate and romantic stay. This was dashed when we discovered on our first day that the Masseria allows people not staying at the hotel to use its facilities. The pool area is open to people from outside, which really ruined the romantic experience for us. An expectation of a quiet and relaxing stay was dashed when on our first full day there were families with screaming children at the pool and garden area, who were not guests of the hotel. The hotel reserves cabanas for hotel guests and sunbeds are for use for outside people. As we wanted to sunbathe in the sun we also wanted to use a sunbed, but they were all taken up by outside guests. We had to resort to lying on the grass while the people who were not staying at the hotel got to enjoy the use of the sunbeds and the facilities. While the hotel does not advertise itself as adults only and children are allowed to stay in the rooms with their parents, dealing with kids from people who aren’t even guests was frustrating. The adjoining restaurant is open to members of the public as well, and while we thought this wasn’t a huge deal to begin with, it create some uncomfortable moments for us. As there are no restrictions for anyone (no cordoned off areas or signs saying hotel guests only), people seemed free to wander around the hotel.

This was my first time encountering bed bugs at a hostel. I stayed here from August 24th to 26th. 1. On the first night, I noticed a strange odor coming from the bed every now and then before falling asleep. Since I’m not one to make a fuss, I tried to ignore it. The next morning, the girl staying in the bunk above me mentioned that she had been bitten by bugs and needed to change beds. At the time, I didn’t think much of it since the bites on my body hadn’t become visible yet. Actually, that afternoon, I went back for a nap and woke up with bite marks. I thought they were mosquito bites, but looking back, they were classic bed bug bites: large, flat, red welts with a small dot in the center. 2. On the second day, I woke up with several obvious bites on my arms and legs. Since I’m usually prone to mosquito bites, I assumed I’d been bitten while out exploring (I really should have checked my body more carefully—I regret it now). The girl from the upper bunk had already moved out and asked if I’d been bitten too. I said no at the time, since accusing a place of having bed bugs is a serious matter. 3. By the third day, the bites on my exposed skin had significantly increased. As my trip was coming to an end, I went shopping and tried on some clothes. It was in the fitting room that I finally took a close look at my entire body—and I was horrified. I had very typical bed bug bites all over my back, shoulders, buttocks, and lower back. There were shocking clusters of bright red welts, with two or three large bites grouped together, inflamed and swollen. I had over thirty bites in total—it was terrifying. I immediately lost all interest in continuing my trip and went back to confront the hostel staff. The staff’s reaction was quite interesting: they repeatedly insisted that "it could be anything." From start to finish, there was not a single word of comfort—just a cold suggestion to "relax" (as if I were making a big deal out of nothing).

Girls do not feel safe there and even get moved during the night by men. And the police even closed that place down. REMOVE THIS HOTEL FROM YOUR PLATFORM!!!!
Location was close to St. Peter's square and close to restaurants. No elevator.

The location was surrounded by vineyards and beautiful views. Lounge chairs and swings provided under shady trees and the swimming pool was much enjoyed by our family. Parking was provided under an open door shelter so we did not have to enter very hot cars. Irene, the host and owner was very helpful in proving information on the restaurants in the area and in Verona. We stayed in the 2 bedroom apartment with each having their own full washroom. We were a family of 6 with 2 grandparents and daughter, husband and 2 boys 11 and 8. The boys slept on a pull out sofa bed. All the beds were very comfortable, even the sofa bed. There is a clothes washer but no dishwasher. Thank you Irene. We had a great time.
Excellent service! The room was comfortable with attention to details. I will definitely come back

Location is amazing..steps to Colosseum. 1 min walk to incredible pizza place. The apartment is very spacious and clean. The bedroom was great, comfy bed and pillows. Having the Kitchen and laundry were great and of course, the air conditioning! Would stay here again next time we're in Rome!! Pullout sofa bed was not comfortable. Apartment looks a bit dated. Shower is very small. Need more chairs in the sitting area. Or better chairs around the dining table.

Our stay exceeded our expectations. It was a beautiful, relaxing setting not far from Venice. The breakfast included fresh eggs from the farm as well as many other delicious options. The pool was a great place to unwind after a day out. The restaurants on site are also very good. Mestre is a short bus/taxi ride away. The staff is very friendly and helpful. We especially enjoyed chatting with Martina at breakfast. Grazie mille! Nothing

The pool is everything, never seen anything like this. The material is soft so much safer for the kids. The cabin was functional, although pretty small. The cabin had some recent renovations but they we not finalized, one of the light switch was not installed leaving wires exposed (with caps) which our toddler was curious about… and was not possible to open a light in the toilet room. The mirrors were also glued with tape on the wall and we found several screw on the floor outside. The location is a bit nowhere (but I guess that make sense as a camping) and the shuttle is quite expensive.

It was a lovely, clean, bright and large apartment in a very central part of Rome. We loved the location that was so close to restaurants, and just a few minutes walk from the Vatican. The apartment itself is well maintained, the kitchen and bathroom were in perfect working order. We had enough cups, plates, etc. The beds were very comfortable and so was the sofa bed. Honestly, this was a real find and the owner was very accommodating and kind and let us leave our luggage in the apartment early. Very kind owner. Thank you so much, you helped us out a lot that day by letting us drop off our luggage early! 🙏🏽

I highly recommend this apartment. Dont hesitate on booking! We had a wonderful stay and our host, Giacomo was so welcoming, helpful, and dedicated to making our stay perfect. He picked us up at the airport at a very reasonable price and also dropped us off. The two ac units kept the entire apartment cool, plenty of towels and the kitchen was fully equipped with a beautiful spread of food waiting for us.. The area felt homey and safe and the kids enjoyed having each their own bed in the second bedroom. This felt like home away from home. Thank you dear Giacomo, you and your apartment were a true gem to our family! Arrivedercci!!

The location of this property is close to public transportation and center. The host met us on arrival and provided information about the room, transportation in the city and places to visit. There was a lot of bottled water provided and snacks always available.

The room’s windows faced the inner courtyard, which made the space feel very peaceful. The girl at reception provided incredible service — thank you so much The lock on our room was a little tricky to use
Well located, friendly staff, nice continental breakfast with clean, comfy room. Perfect for my travels.

Was very clean, everything was perfect Friendly staff and helpful The garage parking was very small for the big cars and difficult to park inside. So we park our car outside the garage Small car will be fine
The customer service was amazing. Location A1 and the breakfast was spectacular.
Location clean and the staff was amazing
Great location!

This place is absolutely breathtaking. If you're looking for a peaceful escape from the stresses of daily life, look no further. The property is set in a dreamy, tranquil landscape, surrounded by the soothing scents of aromatic and botanical plants that give the whole place a unique, serene atmosphere. The rooms are tastefully decorated, spacious, and impeccably clean. The staff are warm, attentive to every need and always available to help with anything, at any time. We also had the pleasure of meeting the owner, who is absolutely lovely and took the time to personally welcome us and say goodbye when we left. such a thoughtful gesture. Thank you for this unforgettable experience — I definitely recommend

The owner very quickly responded to questions. Provided linens, towels, a bottle of water toilet paper for arrival. The house was very clean, had all the basic kitchen needs (pots, pans, dishes, cutlery, glasses, bowls, fridge, stove, oven), a sofa, a hair dryer, a washing machine, and drying racks. Air conditioner worked great, beds were good, and lots of closet space. The location is amazing. So close to the lively town centre (restaurants, shops, market, gelato, game room, bars)and a 5-minute drive or 35-minute walk to the beautiful La Cinta beach. We enjoyed our stay and would rent again. The area has a very good bus system if you don't have a car. The door is tricky to open and lock compared to North America doors.
The place was nice and clean and location is excellent

The comfort and benefits of being in an actual hotel l. 24 hr reception, a pool, they can order you a taxi if needed It was a bit far from downtown, but closer to the airport, but that's what I needed in this case

The room was sparkling clean. Very comfortable bed and the private bathroom was in impeccable condition. Giulia and her husband went far and beyond to make my stay as lovely as possible. I will definitely return again.
Great location, quiet, clean, comfortable and spacious.
As advertised, has air conditioning Like all of our stays prior, we didn't receive check in information until we messaged the host the day of. Some towels were a bit dirty

The location for the suite was spectacular, the 2 front windows looking out onto the sea, just mesmerizing. Wifi available sporadically, AC wonderful 👍🏻 Very close to San Marco Square, 4 min stroll Only 2 bath towels, no wash clothes, no hand towels ! The unit was clean.... Except for the shower stalls; need to be cleaned professionally to remove mold, very visible, unfortunately Would be nice to provide some plastic cups or glasses, a bottle opener perhaps
Staff are excellent hotel is well located and the beach is beautiful Bathroom was tiny. Very uncomfortable
Loved the location and it was spotless !

Fabulous location, central to Tuscany enabling several day trips. Beautiful villa and surroundings. Great size rooms. Kitchen equipment (pots, strainer, water glasses, wine glasses, etc.) was insufficient for 12 or more guests. Cannot accommodate that many people to eat inside. 2 burners on the stove not functioning properly. Guests would benefit from having soap pumps at the sinks (kitchen and bathroom) and extra hand towels in the bathrooms.

The house is cozy, stylishly furnished, and fully equipped with everything you might need, offering breathtaking views of the entire Scopello coastline with its beaches and cliffs. The location is perfect: just a 5-minute walk from the beautiful Guidaloca beach and only a short drive to the Tonnara of Scopello and the Zingaro Nature Reserve. It’s also ideal for families with children, with plenty of space to play in the garden and a very convenient outdoor shower for rinsing off after the beach. Easy parking inside the property. Nothing, the house is perfect to spend a beautiful vacation and discover west of Sicily.
Breakfast and cleanliness On a steep hill
Alessandro and staff were wonderful, home away from home. Neighborhood was quiet, had everything.

Very Clean and centrally located, If we had proper information for the location without having to navigate road closures it would have been much better. The directions provided were not satisfactory and once we arrived we spent 1 hour trying to find parking. After reaching out to prop manager we were told “ you have to park in Mazzini, as I already told you this morning”. Very unhelpful information and communication was short and tempered. Google maps kept circling the property but there was a road closure that made it impossible to pass. I asked if I could pay and sent a picture. 20 mins passed so we walked our bags to the condo and returned to find a “nice present” a 48 Euro ticket. Another 45 min adventure to pay this at the police station. Overall this could have been a great spot for one night but communication spoiled the experience
Staff was professional and friendly.

The location was excellent as we were between the Rialto Bridge and St. Marks Square. It was a perfect location. We could be out exploring during the day and yet close to return home for a break at any time. We were surprised to receive a boxed lunch for our travel day as we were leaving before breakfast was being served - a very nice gesture. There is nothing we didn't like.

What a beautiful appartment !! view 360 on Taormina, from our room we had mountain and sea view . Martina is a wonderful host, very welcoming and helpful. She's easily available if needed. The appartment is clean and spacious. Best breakfast ever with fresh local ingredients.. Great location: The appartment is 10 minutes walk from the center . I would defitly recommend Martina's B&B and stay here again if i come back to Taormina . Everything was fantastic.
Very spacious, bed are confortable, the condo is very well situated. Host reply very quickly and was super helpful. Transportation service to airport was perfect .
Breakfast was good at reasonable price. The service was excellent . Location was average but within walking distance to the Central Railway Station and Grand Canal.
Large quiet apartment, great service, air conditioning in every room, it even has a coffee machine :-) Parking on the street, but it wasn't a problem as there was enough space.

I enjoyed the friendliness of the staff and atmosphere of the hostel. The bathroom looked like it had been mopped with dirty water and there was hair everywhere. This wasn't my experience last time when I stayed the week before, so maybe it hadn't been cleaned or something. Maybe the staff can inform guests who come in late at night to be quiet and keep the noise down.
Very good Needs bigger size shampoos and liquid body wash
Wonderfull couple managing the property Maybe a bit more water pressure ?

We loved our four night stay! The host went out of his way to make us feel welcome! One morning we went hiking early and he even made us a packed breakfast to go! So many lovely details you don’t get in large hotels. Highly recommend this property. Perfect gateway to the Dolomites as well
Friendly staff, excellent location, clean room, comfy bed and air conditioning.

Beautiful resort. Great views. Excellent food. Fabrizio, Francesca and Domenico were exceptional in terms of customer service. The chef's food was exceptional. Original room not properly cleaned. Was moved to a larger room. This one had urine in the toilet bowl when I entered the room. Again, no attention to detail in terms of proper thorough cleaning of rooms. Not enough towels. English was a problem so I had a hard time communicating with front desk staff who were not friendly and certainly not up to par for a 5 star experience. New room also had clogged sink in the bathroom. This all should have been checked before I was moved the This "upgraded room". I would not stay here again due to it not being a 5 star experience. Not worth the money. They need a complete staffing overhaul with experience. I felt badly for the only 3 above average experienced staff: Francesca, Domenico and Fabrizio. The front desk staff should all be re-trained or terminated.

The location is amazing, very central, a short taxi ride from the airport and a short walk to the train. The only reason I gave one 9 and all others were 10, is because some rooms (including mine) do require lifting luggage up some steps (not a full flight of steps).

We had doubts when booking the Economy Room (given how its photo looked), but it turned out great - private bathroom, daily room services, and amaaazing breakfast!! Location was also central. The bathroom always had a strong smell, perhaps the cleaning product used.
The room was clean, spacous, had a private kitchen & bathroom. The hosts were very friendly

- clean, modern and cozy room - super friendly, welcoming people - delicious breakfast with a variety of options - elevator - parking spot - great location - no hot water and water pressure all day, we've been told it's going to be fixed but unfortunately it wasn't and because this is a great location for hikes it was necessary to get a shower

I consider this place as the best accommodation we have stayed in Roma so far for reasons below. I rate accommodation based on my preferences for a place to stay and on the reviews posted. Cleanliness: My top priority. The moment you entered the room, first thing you’ll notice is how clean, neat and modern the place is. Bed is right size with very clean sheets and cover. Private washroom and shower with very clean towels. Amenities: This is a 2 bedroom apartment, so you can rent both rooms for big group. The apartment has a fully equipped shared kitchenette (coffee maker, a refrigerator, microwave, a dishwasher and kitchenware), with air conditioner and heater as well. The building also has a lift which comes handy especially with heavy luggages. Proximity: Very good location and is within walking distance to the Vatican, with shops and restaurants nearby. In addition, taxi stand is just a few steps around the corner of the building which is very convenient when taking a taxi back to airport. Privacy/Security/Space: Near the centre and yet when you are inside the room, you can not hear the outside noise which is a plus. Very secure place (with safety vault inside the bedroom) and spacious with cabinets and drawers. Host: We couldn’t ask for more as Giuliano was a very good host to us. Thank you so much for taking good care of us and making sure that we were comfortable and we have what we need. You also made our stay in Rome memorable. You have a spick and span place, where you can have privacy, feel secure, have a good rest after a long day outside . Grazie mille, Giuliano! I couldn't think of any.
Breakfast was good. Location was great. We were very impressed with the setting of the hotel. Very boutique.

I have stayed at this hotel several times, and it never disappoints. We stopped for a night in Rome the week of our anniversary, and hotel staff decorated our room with balloons. The check in clerk was very kind and did not automatically switch to English when I greeted him in Italian—a very nice touch for a language learner like myself. The room was spacious and clean. Good products in bathroom. There's a pedestrian street behind the hotel with lots of restaurant options. I know that this is a standard practice for many Italian hotels, but having to pay the tourist tax upon arrival is awfully clunky. This should really be a line item at the time of booking.
Extremely helpful arranging pickup from train station and suggesting routes to San Siro Stadium for a Bruce Springsteen concert. Excellent location for Duomo, Metro, Museums and restaurants.
Staff was super friendly and it was really close to the port which was great. Everything was wonderful. Even shuttled us to the cruise ship in the morning Nothing

Good location. Air conditioning. Functional kitchen. Cozy decoration. Nice surroundings. Free parking. Very kind and helpful host, even recommended restaurants and attractions. It would be much better to have mosquito nets, to be able to open the windows and enjoy the Tuscan countryside air.

The location is near the Vatican City, like 10mins walk. No hot water in 2 of the room. Aircon is not working, 37C inside the room all night. One of the room's bathroom is so tiny Too many keys to get into the room

Nice breakfast served in the hotel. Can't get hot food, but good selection of continental cold breakfast. Great coffee, tea selection. Excellent location halfway between Colosseum and Vatican. Bus service outside front door if needed. Great part of town. Our room faced a courtyard, so very quite. Typical compact European room. Would have been great to get some eggs one morning. Had a noisy neighbour one night.
Awesome customer service
Literally everything nothing

Location was absolutely fantastic, exactly what we wanted: only a few steps from the beach! The apartment is much prettier in real life than what the pictures show. we had a nice coffee machine in the hallway, for all guests to use and great coffee pods and mugs inside the room. They also had beach umbrellas available for anyone to use, which we discovered a bit too late. Check in was a breeze, very nice staff. We got in around 10am, and our room was not ready, but with no issue they let us store our luggage at their facilities in the office so we could start enjoying the beach right away (we were beach attired, and had our beach bag ready, so it was perfect). The office is very close from the apartment, so the move with the luggage was not an issue at all. The town is superb, lots of good restaurants, caffes, trattorias, bars, etc. LOVED everything about our stay, I would 100% recommend! There was nothing not to like! We had a bit of a hiccup with the AC, but it didn't last long, and it actually fixed itself, so no complaints whatsoever. We were there mid-July so it was HOT, but we felt very comfortable with the AC in the room.
Location,staff,facilities
Everything great, spacious, comfortable, wonderfly located. Staircase

Comfortable beds. All amenities available. Air conditioning very good. Host response very good. Clean room . Coffee facility available. Opposite was a good late night burger joint Bedroom and shower were a bit small. Location a little far from central

My family and I had the absolute pleasure of staying at The Sorabellas in Gaeta during the month of July, and I can confidently say it was an exceptional experience—one that far exceeded our expectations. If I could give it an 11 out of 10, I absolutely would! From the very beginning, the kind and wonderful owner Michele made us feel cared for. His attention to detail and genuine hospitality began even before our arrival and continued throughout our stay. Communication with him was always fluid, clear, and timely, making everything seamless and stress-free. Michele also provided priceless insights into the local area, helping us discover the best of Gaeta and its surroundings. His recommendations added so much value to our trip and made us feel like locals. The property itself is a gem in the heart of Gaeta—spotlessly clean, modern, and thoughtfully designed with every functional detail in mind. If you're someone who values extreme cleanliness and top-notch facilities, this is the place for you. I truly wish we could have stayed longer. It was more than just accommodation—it felt like home. Grazie mille, Michele, for sharing your beautiful property with my family. We are deeply grateful and already looking forward to returning. A presto!
Staff is amazing, food is interesting. I recommend the all in package. Pools are nice Gym is small. Beach is rocky not sandy as portrayed in photos, they added sand to make the beach more appealing.

We had a comfortable stay here for 2 nights before we flew out from Rome. It was very close to the very lovely beach, restaurant and grocery store. Silvia was also able to connect us with someone to drive us to the airport in the morning, which was much appreciated.
Very, very good Antonia
Great breakfast helpful staff will recommend and stay again Airconditioning can be temperamental

Cristian, the host, was courteous, welcoming, professional. The apartment was half-a-block from the Duomo and restaurants, groceries, bars we all close-by. The apartment is clean, came with all the necessities for our stay and is in excellent repair. Nothing that we can think of at the moment.

It was an easy 10-minute walk (approx.) to the Colosseum. There was nothing else to like. The rooms are in an extremely rundown building in desperate need of attention. This was unknown at the time of booking. It has only a small/narrow service elevator that fits (at most) two luggage and one petite person. We are a family of six with two rooms: floors 3 & 6. We climbed the stairs many times - the walls, floors and ceiling were beyond disgusting, absolutely filthy and in a desperate state of neglect. The walls of both rooms (floors 3 & 6) were badly marked up and dirty. The white sheets on cots had strands of hair (including pubic) and all pillows were covered with a single, open-ended pillow case, with some exposing their extremely aged, yellow/brown tainted fabric. Two cots plus one bed, each had a bug (black in colour, a couple cm in size/approx.). The shower (floor 3) was lined in black mold, (the shower on floor 6 was not inspected so cannot comment on that). The button to flush toilet in bathroom (floor 6) was broken and pushed into the wall, making it hard to flush, and the hanging rod on ceiling light was heavily laden in thick black dust/dirt. The caulking around sink was yellowed and badly separated from the counter top/wall, and the bidet (floor 6) had an unknown obstruction in the drain. The window sheers (upper right panel) and window trim in cot area (floor 6) had groupings of black marks that looked like black mold or bugs. There were wall cracks and similar black markings in other areas/both rooms. Both kitchenettes were dirty, including the utensils, glass wear, stove top, counter top stains, and freezer door in mini fridge (floor 6) was without hinges and fell to the ground when we opened the fridge door. The floor 6 room smelled of heavy cigarette smoke. Both rooms were nothing like the clean, staged website photos. The conditions were disgusting. It was so bad that we left the property after one night and rented a space elsewhere for our last 3 nights in Italy.
everything

Very close to rome bus and train termini... basic upbeat room for a fair price. I did not like the automatic check in. I found it frustrating. Sign on wall says their is an office location in building but no one new anything where it was or nothing posted on Door. Also whatsapp instructions on how to get access to apartment needs to be updated as it said we were staying on second floor and accommodations were actually on 5th floor.

Modest, clean air-conditioned rooms located close to the main strip but far enough that it was quiet in the room. The staff was very helpful and kind. The breakfast offered good selection of sweet and savoury choices, coffee was made fresh upon request. The room was not very big but the beds and bedding were clean and comfortable. We had a little balcony that looked onto the (small) street and it was still rather quiet in the room with doors closed. A small elevator is available otherwise the staircase is what we used mostly. We were there just two nights and saw a few staff members and all were very friendly and helpful. Would recommend as a 'pied-à-terre' in Rimini. No early check-in when we requested it; however there was a bag drop off which is in a little nook next to the reception desk. No issues when we picked them up upon our return from lunch. We used taxis to get around and it's not super quick (surprisingly). We booked an early morning taxi for our departure (upon our arrival!) and was happy to do that because it was confirmed and the taxi arrived on time. I wouldn't leave it to last minute if you are using taxis for transfers. We were there just two nights and saw a few staff members and all were very friendly and helpful. Would recommend.
Location was great. Hosts were easy to communicate with. Apartment was equipped with everything you need. Great stay.
Great service, amazing stuff. They were very helpful. I had some issues on the app. Soft put the staff over there was very useful and very helpful.

Great value for money. Close to bus route towards Venice. Nice breakfast. Friendly and attentive staff, especially the young girl working in the evening who prepared a breakfast box since we were leaving in the middle of the night.

Our stay at Le Muse was excellent. We were looking for a place we could stay at in Sorrento that would allow us to travel the area and this couldn’t have been more perfect. The host, Christina, was incredibly attentive, sending us recommendations for where to go and helped us coordinate travel by sending relevant timetables for transport. Every morning she served us breakfast when we wanted it, and the meal was clearly put together with great care and in a thoughtful manner. We felt safe and relaxed. The AC was also very welcome considering the heat outdoors! Le Muse offers a different experience to a larger hotel, and for our purposes this was preferable. If you want to spend a lot of time at your hotel and use a ton of amenities, Le Muse may not be for you. But if your goal is to see Italy, I can’t think of a better place to stay. -Max and Anna
The location is amazing! Marko is so sweet! Everything was perfect!

The villa is magnificent and really close to several cities which makes it a great base to visit. The establishment is really well equipped and specifically maintained. Everything was perfect, very well taking care of upon arrival and really easy to connect with the owner for any recommendations or questions concerning the regions. We regretted not staying a few days more to truly enjoy this part of the region. It well worth it to stay at villa Pasquy if you want an amazing well located Villa!! Nothing

The location was good and very easy to access public transportation. The main facilities were comfortable and good for a family. The host was accessible when needed. The bathroom was very small. You could not move in the shower, it was barely big enough to turn around.
This was a beautiful and spacious place to stay! I will definitely be back!
Giovanni, the manager is very helpful. None.

Amazing location in central Rome - just steps away from the Spanish Steps. This hotel is nestled on a quiet street just minutes away from shops and restaurants. Check in/out was very smooth without any Issues. Nothing - was a great experience!
Great place. Clean. Enough space. We did not end up meeting Giorgio but our over-the-phone interactions were always pleasant. Quick response. Close walk to the Vatican.
This place is a dream. The trullo, the view, the pool... everything is beautiful and Danila is a wonderful host. We would definitely stay there again. Nothing bad to say.

Our stay at the Hotel Emona Aqueductus was an absolute dream from start to finish. What truly set this hotel apart was the incredible customer-centric communication we experienced even before we arrived. As this was our first trip to Rome, we had a bit of travel anxiety, but the hotel's team was proactive, helpful, and even arranged all our transportation from the airport and later to our cruise port. This thoughtful gesture gave us so much confidence and peace of mind. The front desk staff were simply outstanding. They were genuinely kind, friendly, and went out of their way to ensure every guest felt comfortable and cared for. This warm and personal service truly made us feel like family. We needed two rooms for our family, and they were both fantastic. Our children (a mix of young adults and teenagers) had a spacious and comfortable room for three, while we were given one of their best rooms, #32. This room was a highlight, with a balcony and a spectacular view—the perfect spot for enjoying a coffee in the morning or a spritz in the evening while watching the city below. The rooms were all comfortable, impeccably clean, and well-appointed, making the hotel feel like a true home away from home. Finally, the location was perfect. We felt completely safe walking to all the major attractions, including the Colosseum, which was just a 20-minute stroll away, and to many amazing local restaurants. We can't recommend Hotel Emona Aqueductus highly enough. It's a true 5-star experience that we will never forget!

The location was fantastic. Easy walk to major sites including the Pantheon, Trastevere and Trevi fountain. About 1.5 km to Castel Sant'Angelo. Lots of places to eat nearby. We were able to walk everywhere. Lovely balcony and great air conditioning to combat the heat of Rome. Great self serve breakfast included. Although we did not have a problem this place is not good for those with mobility issues. You have to climb 83 stairs to reach the unit.
Lots of choice. The best coffee! Waffles were delicious Line up for coffee was long. Suggest more machines

My room was wonderful. Climate control ran properly, it was clean and the view was great. Breakfast had a variety of seasonal food and it was well laid out. Maybe it was the time of year but the staff seemed under trained and not as polished as I recall in my previous two experiences here. However, it would not prevent me from coming back.
We really enjoyed the breakfast with many options that would suit everyone
Phenomenal host. Very nice house with all key facilities. Nothing :)

Lovely location and amazing views. The room was very nice and decorated well. It had 2 pools and outdoor kitchen. The staff was helpful. It was clean. Air conditioner did not work because the remote control was not working. It happened at 11 pm, and i did not think i could call the staff at that time. But the staff said we should have called or we could have tried to press the button on the AC unit itself(which was at 3 meters height). The entry door was of large opaque glass, without shutters, so the sun woke us up every morning early. There were no mosquito nets so we could not keep the windows open at night.
The property was close walking distance to sights, dining and shops. It was nicely decorated and new.

Nice room very close from the metro and Colosseum. We enjoyed the restaurants recommendations and the hability to check in early. Small bathroom (typical of Europe). I do not recommend this room if you are overweight because you will not fit in the shower.

Generous stocking of the fridge with drinks and the kitchen with various snacks and coffee. Bathroom amenities were hotel-quality. The furnishings were of high quality and well-maintained. The vibe was chic. Excellent, quiet location in an area near bars, restaurants and little boutiques that felt local, not touristy. Helpful host. Uber Taxi did not seem to like the location at 7am so we had to walk out to the main street a few hundred meters dragging our luggage over the bumpy stone streets to find a taxi stand.

Breakfast was lovely. Andrea was more than accommodating. Very comfortable apartment with many extras. Very central location. Exceedingly clean. A/c worked well. Only downside to this apartment is the lack of a living area. Also there are 2 flights of stairs and no elevator so not suitable for someone with mobility issues. Andrea kindly brought our suitcases up and down for us.
It was a huge space and in a great location! Could have more stocked in the kitchen - salt, oil etc

I loved the decoration, the house itself and the huge garden around the house. It was like living my own Italian dream. It is located around 45 minutes to 1 hour from the centre of Rome. We went to a little town just 10 minutes away in car and had dinner there. It was lovely. The house also offer dinner for additional price and breakfast was included. The breakfast was a typical Italian breakfast with sweet pastries. They also had a big cooffe machine to make cappuccino and latte. The place was very clean. I didn't like that I had a flat tire on the road while driving from the south and I contacted the property to inform them I was gonna do a late check in and they said that after 21:00 I had to pay around 25 euros and if the check in was after 22:00 I had to pay even more. I understand that if someone do a late check out, the host will charge the person but I have never been charged for a late check in. They could have had a better customer service and accommodate us. Also, the bedroom was lacking light. It was dark.

We really enjoyed our stay! The host was wonderful. Very responsive and helpful. She sent a number of great recommendations. The location was also great for easy access to the train station and for walking around the city.
Great Breakfast, Great Staff, 5 Minute walk to the beach, restaurants, etc.
