The location was exceptional, close to supermarkets, restaurants, train and bus station. The decor was exquisite and there was absolutely everything needed to make one feel like they were right at home. Beds were also cozy and the place was spacious.
It was far enough away from the main strip of Lido, but close enough for our 6 year old not to complain. Easy access to the beaches and closeness to shops and coffee!

Modern, comfortable, and clean room in country setting 2+ km from Venice airport. Breakfast was excellent. Hosts are very welcoming and provide all info you need about local area and transfers to/from airport and Venice City Center.
Very good

The hotel is spotlessly clean and in a very quiet building. Breakfast was delicious, especially the pastry. The staff were wonderful - very thoughtful and helpful with arrival and departure, as well as great restaurant recommendations! The location is great - even though the hotel is on a busy shopping street, the hotel itself is very quiet. It's just a short walk to the Metro and train stations, and very walkable to attractions like the Spanish Steps or Colosseum. Not a complaint, just a suggestion: as someone who has chronic neck trouble, I always appreciate newer pillows when I can't travel with my own!

If you're looking for peace and quiet off the beaten path, this is it. Quite the opposite of Cortina D'Ampezzo, very quiet, not to say isolated, and frequented mostly by Italian tourists, it comes at the cost of lower elevation mountains and less spectacular scenery. The nearest towns of Cavalese and Tesero are quaint and have several good restaurants and at least one supermarket. The drive to Bolzano seems short, at 20-some kilometers, but it will take you 45 minutes on narrow, windy mountain roads. The restaurant has an excellent breakfast, quite lavish, and very friendly and helpful staff - we loved the staff here. The indoor/outdoor pool is very nice for kids and there are good hiking opportunities nearby. I would be tempted to return here at a lower room price. Note: this is a summer review. The hotel is located right on a secondary road that may see some traffic in the tourist season, but soundproofing is good. A car (or strong legs and a bike) is almost mandatory in this area, even to get to the nearest town. 300 Euro a night seems rather pricey for what it offers, even in August, but the hotel is nevertheless full. Apartments are cleaned once a week, and an extra charge is required for daily cleaning, which seems unusual for a 4-star hotel.
We really enjoyed our stay here!
The host was very helpful and communicated very well. The location of the property is stunning and was a great hub for visiting the Aosta valley.

The building and room were beautiful and very clean. The staff were very polite and helpful. There was water, tea and cookies for guests in the room. Overall, it was a great stay and great value for money. The room was cold, but better with the window open.
Great Location. Very accommodating

Elisabetta was a fantastic host and was so helpful. There are so many thoughtful details at Bellavista and a lot of effort has gone into making sure everyone who visits has a great stay. The location is ideal for exploring Certaldo and the surrounding areas. Really nothing I could fault, there is a small amount of noise outside in the square in the evening especially on the weekend, if you like it to be silent, but it didn’t bother us.

Antonio's property was in the perfect location, central, close to the beach and shops and a view that is second to none. Loved the 2 tiered terrace with outdoor shower, patio furniture, lounge chairs, umbrellas and excellent lighting. The AC worked excellent and Antonio was the greatest host, always available and made our vacation an amazing one ! Thank you Antonio and we will definitely be back. 😊👍❤️🥂 Loved everything !

The time we spent was magical. A little slice of heaven outside Siena. Simone was so helpful and kind. He gave us so many brilliant recommendations. The apartment was spacious, very clean, new, and incredibly well-stocked. It was also very well-priced. We will fondly remember our morning coffees in the yard. Hope to visit one day again. 10/10. Almira/Brian

The hotel location is right across the street from the beach and just down the street from dozens of great restaurants and the piazza. The breakfast was amazing for the price The furniture in the room was older, but not a big deal.
Great location in the centre of Bolzano. Beautiful large airy, modern apartment. The stairs up to the apartment. Thankfully my husband carried our suitcases.
Beautiful rooms and Anna was friendly and helpful. It was close to thr train station, market and lots of coffee nars and restaurants.
Amazing location near St. Magdalene chruch and there is bus accesibility. The view is beautiful!

Very clean and comfortable accommodation. Excellent location close to bus stop for easy access to Venice. Excellent host. Picked us up from train station and gave us great instructions. Would definitely stay here again.

We had the most wonderful experience staying at this charming B&B, just a 10-minute walk from the castle — a perfect location for exploring the area without needing a car. The setting is both peaceful and picturesque, with a balcony view while enjoying your morning coffee that’s hard to beat: lush gardens and a glimpse of the castle in the distance. It’s a scene that feels like it’s been plucked from a storybook. The breakfast each morning was a real highlight — fresh, generous, and absolutely delicious. You can taste the quality and care in every bite, much of it sourced directly from the garden just outside. The rooms and bathrooms were immaculately clean, beautifully decorated, and clearly designed with thought and intention. From high-quality mattresses to well-placed charging stations in every room, everything you could need for a comfortable stay has been anticipated. The B&B is Davide’s childhood home, and that warmth is felt in every corner. The philosophy here is simple but powerful: treat every guest like they’re loved and part of the family — but never at the expense of professionalism. Catrin, Davide and the Conte family truly go above and beyond. From sharing local tips to recommending the most fantastic restaurants and spa experiences, their guidance added so much to our trip. This wasn’t just a stay — it was an experience of genuine hospitality, connection, and care. We’ll absolutely be back.
Clean with amazing facilities. Super close walk to Lungomare/centre. Fitness centre was AMAZING and so waa the breakfast, amazing selection. Tons of parking available.

comfy bed, nice room well furnished, good breakfast, When I arrived at Marco Polo, the shuttle booked 3 weeks in advance was not there. After waiting 30 min, we took a taxi till the hotel. I told the front desk staff that I did pay a taxi becasue no shuttle was waiting for us.
Great location. Comfortable beds. Breakfast not very good - room crowded, often insufficient food supply; fruit all canned! Only one main elevator working during our three day stay.

The host was very kind and welcoming, and the apartment itself was very clean, which we really appreciated. However, there were several downsides to the stay that future guests should be aware of. The Wi-Fi connection is extremely limited—it only worked reliably in the stairwell or the bathroom. The location is quite remote, far from everything, and unfortunately, there's no view at all despite being in a hillside area. There is ongoing construction nearby, and while we didn’t have any direct issues, the neighbors didn’t seem very friendly—we often felt uncomfortable coming in or out of the property due to the stares. Also worth noting: there is no parking space included, and you’ll need to pay €4 per night to park in a nearby area. Overall, if you're looking for a very quiet and isolated stay and don’t need strong internet.. this may suit your needs. But for us, the lack of connectivity and difficult location made it a challenging stay, despite how lovely the host was.
The location was conveniently close to the train hub and within walking distance of several historic landmarks, restaurants, and other hotels. The area felt safe to walk around at night.
Location/ Location / Location

First off our plane was delayed 3x and then cancelled. Adrianna our hostess texted us in the late evening when normally people should be asleep. She arranged a driver( Bruno) who was also fantastic to pick us up with our luggage. The place is impeccable! Beautiful and clean. Better than in the pictures. I can't say enough about our beautiful hostess. She is caring and helpful and truely loves helping her guests. I definitely would stay here again. . I don't like that I can't give her a higher rating because she deserves it.

Due to a delayed flight, we arrived outside of the requested check-in period (3-8pm), but we kept in touch with the staff via Booking.com, and they were very gracious and stayed until we arrived (almost 9:45pm). The hotel is on the second floor of a gorgeous old building right in the heart of Florence, and is a close walk to everything. Our room was very quiet and clean (with a beautiful fresco on the ceiling), and the air-conditioner worked well enough that we didn't suffer during the heat wave. The staff was also happy to order us a regular taxi to get to the airport (which arrived in 5 minutes). We asked them how much we should expect to pay, and the taxi bill was within a few euros of their estimated amount (€34, which was much better value than a private driver!) A tip for those who are coming from the airport; when we arrived, there wasn't a single taxi at the airport, and it was impossible to call one via Uber (it would not connect us to a driver). There was also a lineup of about 100 people waiting for a taxi. It would have taken us all night! Either pre-arrange for a taxi to pick you up, OR, you can also take the tram. Just follow the instructions provided by the hotel on this site. It was very easy, and I think it cost us €3.50 for two people. The room (and bathroom) was a bit small, but that is to be expected in Florence.

Location was great and the apartment seemed safe as the main door was always locked. The apartment was spacious. All of the table and countertops were dirty - I wiped down rings from coffee cups and other dirt easily with a wipe. So no one had even attempted to clean them - not impressed that it wasn't clean upon our arrival. Extra blankets were stained yellow as if they were 100 years old and not sure if they were actually clean or not. Also, I believe check in is anytime after 2pm, but they only have someone there to give you the key until 4pm. Luckily, we arrived before 4pm, but if we did not, we were told that we would need to send photos of our passports and credit card over email in order to check in. This is not a safe procedure, booking.com has a banner explicitly telling clients to NOT send information such as identification and credit card information via email. I would not stay here again unfortunately.
We had a rate without breakfast. The room was adequate, but a bit damp due to sub-street level situation. The location is outstanding in the pedeatrian-only old city.

Loved the location near the beach. This hotel has a beach like feel to its rooms. An eclectic feel. Getting to the hotel from the airport without the cheaper shuttle service the hotel offers most days was very expensive. Regular airport taxi service is a rip-off.

This is the second year in row when we chose Schloss Hotel Korb to stay in the Bolzano neighborhood. All conditions are excellent. Fritz Dellago is an incredible host, being present everywhere and paying attention and having something to each one of his guests. We travelled many places but did not experience so much consideration from owners.

As requested, we confirmed by email that we would arrive at 1:30 pm. August 3rd, 2025. We found the address and entered through an open door, because workmen were loading debris onto a truck. There was no signage for Black Rooms Colosseo, so we had no idea where to check-in. We walked up two flights of stairs but still didn't see any instructions. We phoned the number listed on our reservation but no one answered. A woman entered the building and told us to go to the 6th floor. There, we found a door labeled Black Rooms Colosseo but it was locked. The same phone number was posted so we phoned again - no answer! As we left the building, a man entered with a lady carrying a suitcase. I told him we were there to check in and fortunately, he was the person who should have met us there. It was now after 2:00 pm. We waited while he took the lady to her room and then he took us to our room. Not sure what we would have done if we hadn't personally connected.
Everything like in the picture. Beautiful views, nice pool, tennis courts, great spacious newly renovated apartment with great kitchen, all new appliances and kitchenware. Will be back!

New, clean, comfortable bed. Very nice overall. Could sometimes hear the external door closing in the morning because our room was right next to it. Would also appreciate if there was hair conditioner provided but I'm not sure if this is standard in Italy.

Location was ok. Self check in is the only option. I'm confused about how others love the hosts that never appear. Looks pretty in pictures but rather Impractical. Shower was terrible. The only true thing is the stairs to get to the apartment. Restaurant suggestions sucked. Find your own restaurants as they are all around you. But get the list to know which ones to avoid.

Clean comfortable and very good staff especially Laura and house keeper. Eggs and bacon are not warm Nothing for breakfast was that great, hoping for fresh authentic Italian food but all packaged not good.7

Aldo was a fantastic host, kind and generous. Our accommodation was clean, comfortable and affordable and in a quiet residential neighborhood. It was easy to walk to the main sights in town. Great food nearby. Aldo drove us to the port the next morning to catch our ship. Having to leave!
Amazing rooms

We loved the location and views from the balconies! We had a few of the mountains and the ocean. We were right in the centre of the village although the village isn't rowdy so it is quiet in the evening and mornings. There was nothing we didn't like. Well, maybe if the mattresses were more comfortable. They were too hard for me. I ended up sleeping on the cot.

Erica was kind, helpful, joyous, and takes a lot of pride in this property. It is roomy yet cozy, in the mountains with a gorgeous view of the Ligurian sea. The breakfast was a wonderful touch, and she also helped me with admin for my trip.I couldn't handle myself because of the language barrier. She is an incredible host and anyone who comes to visit Finale would be lucky to stay with her.

We liked the location and how large the space is. The AC was great as it was quite hot. The bed and pullout were comfortable and we slept well. It has everything needed to cook a meal. There are restaurants close by and a little grocery store next to it.
Location was great. Exceptionally responsive host. Room was very roomy with a couch.
Location is great. Very outdated and dark
Dark room, no clothes line as promised, one tiny waste paper basket, a wall clock that didn't work, no desk as promised.
Close to the lake and center, the lift help with the luggage (there's a lift for people and another on for "things"). Havind a parking spot was great. The room is spacious for my group of 4 people.

Spacious room, always clean with good, reliable air conditioning which is a must in Naples….The staff at the reception was very helpful and provided some good tips. The rooftop restaurant was fabulous… very good food and original cocktails. The staff was attentive and the service was excellent….went back a second time. Kudos to the chef who grilled the perfect beef filet ! Right around corner from the hotel, you can purchase tickets for the 24/7 hop on hop off bus tour and just a few minutes walk away at the Garibaldi Terminus you can join a pre-booked day trip tours such as those to the Amalfi coast or Pompei. Location is good with all necessary amenities nearby such as small food markets, pharmacies, restaurants and shops but some shady people in the area so need to be vigilant walking mostly at night…. must say never felt unsafe, though.
So hard to find and the host was not available when we called while trying to find the place.
The rooms were very nice. This was our sixth hotel in Italy and it by far had the most comfortable bed and pillows yet! The bathroom was a bit small.
The location is good! The hotel management was not helpful at all in helping a first-time-visitor to the city
The place is very nice and is very peaceful and pretty Walking up the hill after 11pm was difficult for my wife and sister in law

Real authentic historic italian familly home. Everything is comfortable spacious and clean. The welcome pack was great. It is a great base for exploring Tuscany. Giada was a great host Parking is 150 m away. It is free during the night but it costs 1 eur per hour during work hours
Spacious 3 Rooms to spread out Perfect location

The bedrooms were large and very well appointed. It had a balcony and overlooked a charming neighbourhood. The kitchen had all the facilities you would expect. We loved the basket of buns and toasted bread with jam. Tea and coffee provided. The location was a 2 minute walk to the bus stop that gets you directly into the centre of the city. The host Mr. Enzo was very helpful in providing tips to visit the attractions.

Breakfast was lovely. No one was there to let us in. We had to wait in the street for 30 minutes. The courtyard was very dirty. It looked there had been some event and there were dirty glasses and litter. Bathroom not acceptable shower scary.

The emplacement of the room in the city is perfect. The room is large and has climatisation Inaction and no communication to solve problems. Here is what happened during my 5 day stay : -We arrive on the 5th of July and have to go pick up our keys at my tale hotel. The lady at the front desk gives us the keys and tells us that she « thinks its the good keys and that she thinks our room is on the first floor . If we have problems with the keys we should call her ( See pictures but its a 34 min walk from the hotel to our room; and we have luggages). We ended up having no problems with the keys but the fact that the person at the front desk told us there could have been isnt reassuring. -When we arrive at the room we have 3 problems. 1. The safe isnt usable 2. The TV is out of service 3. None of the 3 wifi network actually provide wifi. (We bought little international data on our phone but we plan to use them out of the room for google maps or emergency) 4. We booked a SOUNDPROOF room as advertised. wasnt sound proof, we heard noise from the street and corridor as if they were in our room. I can manage noise but what bothers me it is advertised as soundproof and really isnt. I notify the Hotel through email (because i can’t find their number on whatsapp). They tell me they are sorry and can’t do anything right now but will fix the issue the next morning. -After a lot of back and forth by email on the 6th here is what the Hotel offers : The next day (the 7th) they will take our bags and move them to an other room. During that email exchange the employe can’t tell me where the room will be, how we will get the keys, when we will get the keys, if the wifi works over there. He assures me that i will receive an email in the morning to give me all the details. -The 7th we leave out bags in the room at 11am, we still havn’t got an email. At noon i send an email saying its no longer morning and im waiting for some news like promised. At 4 we leave our guided tour of the vatican early and walk to our room.

Very good location right at the waterfront. Beautiful restaurant and wonderful buffet breakfast. Large apartment. large bed. The town is beautiful. Although this place promotes itself as being bike friendly and has photos of bikes on balconies, the elevator is so small you need to bring your bike up vertically. Pretty challenging for me. The decor is really basic - like student accommodations at a hostel. The kitchen area needed a good scrub. Very expensive.
attention to detail, innovative room layout, comfort

The host was very accommodating of our changing arrival time, very friendly and took care to have a small breakfast and coffees available in the morning. The room.had air-conditioning that worked well enough. The 3 large dogs barked everytime someone arrived or left. Our last night there one of them was jumping and barking at someone while we were trying to come in the gate and the host had to come call it off. The listing said no children, but we listened to a very noisy one for a couple of hours while trying to sleep. There wasn't soap in the bathroom. Our shutters wouldn't close all the way so everyone smoking outside on the front lawn had a great view into your room. It wasn't relaxing nor particularly pleasant and it was €99 a night ... but it was at least a place to sleep. It was "sort-of fine". Not recommend especially if you want to siesta before any evening activities.
Perfect location, clean rooms, really nice and silent. A bit difficult to reach the first floor by stairs - but we were aware of it.

The location is great to visit the sites in La città antica. You can walk everywhere. It is very close to the Arena di Verona Very good communication with Massimo and excellent service. Everything was great.

Did not apply. We were not provided with any information Need more pillows for the bed. Need to provide hangers for clothes. Dishwasher was difficult to use. Towels for drying dishes should be provided.
Wish we could have stayed longer!

Wow…What an exceptional hotel.We waren’t sure what to expect,but everything was beyond amazing!! The room ,the location,the staff,the heated pool and the beautiful garden. The view from our room was beautiful. Definitely ,we can’t wait to come back. Thank you Marianna,for your hospitality! Nothing to complain
Very clean and well kept place, enjoyed the quietness of the location. Not much really, good value for the money
The family that runs the hotel was great. The breakfast, dinner, and chacouterie were outstanding.
Hotel perfect location from airport. Easy access by bus to venice. Clean and comfortable I would highly recommend

Great room, excellent sea view, very nice and substantial breakfast, friendly stuff. The only and minute issue was the TV which was of relatively small size and it was not SmartView to watch YouTube, Netflix, etc.

The proximity to the Milano centrale metro. Unfortunately extreme heat prevented a lot of site seeing opportunities. The elevator floor was in need of a good cleaning Our room had a view of the parkade
Very large room, updated decor, big bathroom, amazing location.

Very helpful staff who went above and beyond to help us. Very well-appointed rooms with thoughtful amenities (i.e., amenities box containing make-up removal pads, Q-Tips and an elastic band…they obviously considered the needs of their female patrons, thank you!). I would just suggest adding a sign to the entrance to the parking area. It is very easy to miss the first time for those unfamiliar with the roads; it would be very helpful.

Francesco. ( host) was very welcoming and accommodating for all our needs. The room was excellent prepared and equipped. Very clean. The location is very quiet and convenient to reach all attractions.

The breakfast was really delicious, the location was stunning, the farm was very beautiful and the weather was great throughout our stay. The hosts made us feel very welcome and had great recommendations. The room was quite big, and the outside private patio was a really nice touch. It was very relaxing to stay here, we had a wonderful time! This is a great place to stay to explore the beaches and cities near by, we were able to visit Lecce and Otrante, as well as many beaches and Cava di Bauxite. Two small notes, one being that the room had a very strong perfume to it, we believe it was for the curtain to the outside that was sprayed to keep out bugs. My partner and I are very sensitive to scent so it took some getting used to. I was also sad to see that the restaurant was not open during our stay, I had not seen that it was closed before arriving. However, these things are very small and did not impact our stay all that much!

Such a gorgeous BNB in the most perfect location. Walking distance from the train, and to explore Palermo on foot. The BNB is beautifully renovated in a gorgeous old building. The bed is very comfortable and the breakfast was perfect, and very generous! I really appreciated Paola's communication and recommendations for great restaurants. Thank you. I highly recommend!
Fantastic location. Rooms were perfect. Antonio is kind and friendly. I will definitely come here again when I come back to Rome
Friendly owner, great location, great for a short stay, clean. Too bad I had to leave so early, missed the breakfast!

Peaceful resort away from the hustle and bustle of Alghero. Quick drive into town for dinner. The restaurant is incredible and very romantic - highly recommend. Loved that we had a patio with out room. Staff were very friendly as well! Breakfast selection average for the cost. Overall would still recommend to friends and family for a stay!

Everything! Welcome - very good. Staff polite and very helpful. Room very good spacious and comfortable, Dinner in the Bistro - superb. Ambience - excellent, Breakfast - very good. The only difficulties lay in arrival by car. Even with satnav it proved difficult to locate plus the telephone number of the hotel was answered by a computer and was not a direct line. Seeking help this way drew a complete blank.
No AC, and if you open the window, you can't sleep due to the noise of the train .
BreakfAST and staff were great!

The location was close to everything and our host was very accommodating when we arrived early. The upstairs air conditioner was broken and the upper two floors were too hot to utilize. There was also a neighbouring child who constantly shrieked, echoing off the walls of the building making the terrace uncomfortable during the evenings.
Hotel is well located near stores and restaurants, loved the facilities that when you can reat in the sauna or jaalccuzzi after a long day out an about

Location,location,location. View was excellent and within easy walking distance of town centre and train station. Would definatley book again and advise family and friends it is a great place to stay. Hostess was great and immediatly responded to any questions we had. Only concern is stairs to enter accomodation and walking distance from amenities for an older individual or person with mobility issues. May want to ensure potential clients are made aware of this.
Everything is good

Space (room is very spacious), facilities (everything in the room was just great), breakfast ( breakfast à la carte served in your room), location (it was near everything that was of interest for us) and service (they greeted us with respect and were attentive to our every needs). There isn't one thing we didn't like. We plan to go back for our next trip to Napoli. Although everything was perfect, we think it could benefit from a few things such as a box of tissues in the bathroom, a brush to clean the toilet (as we saw in Rome) and maybe a microwave.
I arrived early and they accommodated me. The room was absolutely amazing. One of the cleanest, modern rooms I have ever stayed in. Not a thing

Rooms are recently renovated. From the moment I arrived there was no one at the front desk. They left my room unlocked with the key inside which I did not appreciate. While the room was fairly clean I noticed some hairs on the bedding and inside the washroom. The bigger issue was that there was no toilet paper and it took them 8 hours to respond to my message about this. Wifi was poor and didn't reach my room. The main area and hall smells of a pungent perfume and the longer I was there I could tell it was trying to cover up an unpleasant smell. Breakfast was the typical pastries/cakes, no eggs or freshly prepared food. During checkout the employee (only one I saw in-person my whole trip) didn't seem to know how to use the card machine and almost made me late for my flight. Lastly the property is located in a not very nice area of town and is mostly abandoned. Wouldn't walk alone at night here.
Nice breakfast, and very clean hôtel,comfortable bed

The location is close to the beach and different restaurants. The place is clean and easy to use facilities. The breakfast is a good selection of baked goods and coffee. Leandro is an amazing host and very helpful. He recommended a good seafood restaurant to experience local food. He also advised how to easily navigate Rome.
Great responsive staff, very clean, open patio was a bonus. The neighborhood was very noisy after hours. Kids playing in front of the building until after midnight 4 of 5 nights.
There was no breakfast. Breakfast would have been nice or at least coffee in the room would have been great. Coffee machine in the room. Breakfast would be great. And a safe.
What a gem! Such a peaceful and historical place. Great stating point for hikes on the back QT paths

Its in a good location in the old town. Its very close to local amenities and shops. Staff, whilst not available on a face to face basis were contactable via whatsapp. Also, the staff as we were leaving were very helpful. This is not a B&B, it's an Airbnb. Each bedroom is off a common breakfast space with minimal privacy. When one person gets up, everyone else can hear them. As a result, it's not worth the cost of booking the room, and we were very disappointed.

At arrival the host permitted to leave the luggage in the hall. Air conditioning is a saver in a hot weather. Our bad experience started with the rude host that immediately ruined our experience with the place. He is requiring an hour to be there. Just note that the public transport doesn't run as per Google schedule, is late either doesn't appear. That is why we were late 16 min prior to the hour that we informed. I wrote that we will be around 11h00 so I wanted to pay and do check in, and then he could leave the key after 15h00 as per instruction received before. We needed the room only in the evening because I had bought tickets to visit places. He refused. So after visiting we headed to the place. Unfortunately due to public transport we were late 16 min. I wrote a message and apologized and told to him he can go to do check in to other person and I can wait without any problems. He refused and then started to talk about late fee. When booked I was sure is a hotel. But not is an apartment with the bathroom outside the room even worst that Airbnb. So it is not clear indicated on booking that is an apartment. Good that the bathroom was not outside on street. Cleanliness was an issue - there was a ton of hair in the shower (gross). The floors were dirty and clearly hadn't been cleaned for awhile with hair, dust and dirt all over. The entry door is alitle tucked away so it was a bit tricky finding initially. We had a chalange to open the old doors. The mattress and pillows also felt medieval as if they were stuffed with hay and indented as if a donkey had laid on it. The shower looked like a prop from 'back to the future' Time Machine to the 80's. The host offered water and coffee but didn't touch to it because was afraid not to be charged as cleaning service. Bref the worst experience we had ever booked with booking. If I knew that this is an apartment with bathroom outside the room ( didn't even know that this could exist) I would had been looking and paying more for a real hotel room.

The pool, grounds, food, and wine was exceptional! Rosanna was extremely prompt when asked a question! The entire staff at Borgi provided exceptional customer service. Our room was immediately above the kitchen, and we had no view from our room. The shower in both of our rooms was not very good!

It was central but a bit difficult to find. The apartment was spacious enough to accommodate our family. It was a hot summer day and the AC did not always work. We think it might have been controlled by the management company. When we called to complain about it, all of a sudden we were able to turn it on. During the night they turned it off remotely so we were really hot. We messaged but didn't hear back until late in the morning.

The woman who welcomed me was helpful. Ricardo as well. Another staff member gave us advice on how to protect our belongings in Roma subways. The restaurant team members are amazing (breakfast and dinner). The food is very good and I had half board with the room. They should tell customers about the shuttle service they have. The first room they assigned me was awful. The smell was horrible, There was a continued noise. I don't even know how they can offer this room to customers. Fortunately, they switched me to a much better room 5-6 hours after my check-in.

Clean and location No concierge physically. Used what's app to communicate. Took 30 to 45 min to locate roon at check in. Front door was physically locked at night, could not get back in. Very stressful by what's app before I was let in. Never going back here

Super responsive host, clear instructions from the start. The property was perfect for our needs, the view is worth all the money! The balcony is wonderful and there is a true "indoor-outdoor" feel to the apartment. The kitchen has all you could need. The property is a 20 minute drive from Monterosso, where there is 24hour parking at 2.5 Euro an hour, which is a great place to park and start your hiking adventure through the towns. This was no problem to us, but just a warning that you need to park on the curb of the road, so you may need to walk a minute or two if there are many guests staying at the same time.
Quiet and convenient to the port
Lovely spot and facilities Parking was a nightmare, be prepared to pay and walk quite a distance.
Up renovated, comfy and cozy at the same time with a little touch of style

I was travelling to Pescara for the first time with my daughter and Carducci 83 was absolutely perfect. The location was unbeatable in a safe neighbourhood steps away from the beautiful beach and steps away from the center. The apartment was extremely clean and had everything we needed including a delicious breakfast. The host was extremely accommodating and always available to help us out. He provided us with many suggestions for great places to eat in town all of which were excellent. We strongly recommend this accommodation and look forward to returning!

Very welcoming, Cleaness, Provied accurate information (recommended restaurants), Quiet neighborhood, Bus access - airport shuttle terminal, chapel at the basement! Shower room drain was a bit clogged ..

No breakfast provided Nobody present to greet us. We did not have easy access to unit. Left to wait in park area in front for hours when the condo was available! Thankfully a stranger from Rome, offered to call owner. They should not assume that all travellers have access to calls in Europe other than WhatsApp. We were stopped from entering for $9 euros of tourists tax that we had planned to pay in person. After providing proof of this payment, we were provided code to a lock box that had a key. An ANCIENT Roman key that you had to turn 4 times to unlock 4 locks embedded in the door that you could not see. Again, no instructions from owner! Nothing like Canada. When you enter the front door, you are greeter with a garbage fowl smell! They line up bins at entrance! The staircase up to unit was narrow, walls dirty. It did not feel safe. Go up flights of stairs with heavy luggage, narrow, NO WORKING elevator. Not well lit. Kitchen not clean. Shower had mould in grout. We were 3 guests, not enough towels. Owner was fully paid in advance with our proof iof passports and then when we arrived, was not easy to reach! We felt we were scammed. Glad it was only for ONE night.

The view from the hotel is great, the staff was very friendly and informative, and the breakfast was really nice. The location made getting around very tough. It's located midway between Sorrento and Positano, but the shuttle only goes to Sorrento. If you wanted to go to Positano, you had to shuttle to Sorrento, then back track on the local bus, or hope that it stopped for you on the way (which is most often doesn't). The first shuttle also doesn't go until 8AM. We had an early train to catch, which meant our only options were to either take a very expensive taxi or drop our bags in town the night before and hike down the mountain. The beds were also quite stiff and the pool closes very early.

Manager was amazing! Very helpful with advice and offered for me to stay in the breakfast area if I wanted as my train wasn't leaving for 3 hours. Head of the bed was in an area with just enough height to not bang your head if you were careful. I got a bit of a bump.

The breakfast was good, and the staff were very friendly, which made the experience pleasant. However, there was a noticeable lack of variety in the food offered each day. For example, boiled eggs were the only egg option available, and the selection of sweets—such as pies and cakes—stayed the same throughout our stay. Adding more variety to the daily menu would really enhance the overall experience. That said, the location was excellent, and the receptionists were incredibly nice and helpful. Even when we had to leave early in the morning, they thoughtfully provided us with a take-out breakfast. These small touches made a big difference and were very much appreciated.

the location was excellent it allowed you easy access to the main strip and the views were spectacular there was really nothing to complain about everything was perfect and the hotel was very accommodating

Location was great. Biagio, the host, was very responsive and helpful. He did not greet us since we were there on the weekend, but his Italian staff did great job at showing us around the room. The water in the shower was difficult to get constant temperature (from Hot to cold without changing anything)

I think the location is not in the centre . the room is big enough enough for three. it is the first time for me using Airbnb. little trick for me like how to entry the building and how to entry the room . final we are fine.
Room was comfortable, clean, great balcony facing the mountains. Breakfast was excellent, well laid out, variety, plentiful.
The location was great, as well as the lady at the check in desk! It wasn't as clean as we thought it would be based on the reviews. The shower was moldy and the bedrooms were not that clean.

The location is excellent and close to not only some big attractions but also the bus and subway lines which makes it exceptional for getting around. The host was exceptional as well. We had some complications with the booking and they were very accommodating and in constant communication with us in order to resolve the situation and provided a positive outcome for me and my family. The price is a bit much, however that is not exclusive to this place alone. Rome is a massive tourist hub and you're paying for its location above all.
The breakfast was the typical Italian breakfast. We liked the location of this B&B as it was a walking distance to the center of Frascati and it was gated in a quiet neighborhood. Nothing

Everything about this apartment was outstanding! Starting with the most genuinely welcoming and friendly host Bianca, who made sure we had a perfect stay (organized complimentary pick up and drop off to her apartment, stocked the fridge and even left some presents for our kids), to the best location in the old town, to the cleanliness and everything else that made our stay perfect stay in Poligano. We will be back- thanks Bianca! Nothing not like!

Excellent communication with Federico, the host. Easy check-in and check-out. Good flexibility. Federico connected by whatsapp the day prior and provided great links for places to visit and eat. Federico responded to messages with no delays. Everything went fine
everything is perfect, the location, clean, room I was hoping finding power plug non standard to charge my phone

the Location is heaven! No words can describe the beauty!!! The hotel is clean and safe. They gave my friend a free upgrade. The staff are kind but you won't see that on their faces, their facial expressions doesn't show you that but they are really helpful and nice. Don't expect full service and assistance, you shall carry your own luggages to your room, but it is not a big deal they do have a lift and The hotel is BEAUTIFUL! Bring your water and snacks for the room we forgot and the nearby restaurants close early.

location excellent breakfast acceptable carpet at entrance dirty not very appealing when first walking in hotel is aging from previous visits furniture in room poor condition and aged air condition needed to be plugged and unplugged to function
Clean and large apartment ideal for a family or two couples. Stunning views of surrounding mountains.

Great staff, very friendly and welcoming. Perfect location to visit Vatican, Castel Sant Angelo. Great restaurants nearby. We had a beautiful large room with a lovely bathroom. A good breakfast was included. Loved staying here. Loved it all.
Beach was beautiful. Staff was amazing. Want to go back!! Some beds were too short for my 6.3 ft tall kids (lol)
Excellent view, excellent service. Always available to help with questions or guidance. Lisa organized all my transportation needs. Reservations to private beaches.

Massimiliana ( the host) was very helpful. She answer very quickly and help me with direction how to get in the bus from the airport. Clear information very kind woman. The place is very clean. She make me feel at home. Very nice way to start my trip in Italy. Grazia Massimiliana! 🤗
Very nice room and convenient spot, tiny bathroom but designed very well for small space. Pictures don't do it justice. Very nice room Comfortable bed.. Grazie All good
Very kind hotel/restaurant owners and clean and budget-friendly hostel. Location is great for exploring the area.

The property was in a great location and quiet. The staff where helpful and friendly. The breakfast buffet had a great selection with indoor or outdoor seating. The restaurant recommendations did not disappoint. Thanks Luka for getting us settled when we arrived and all your helpful tips. Will definitely stay when in Venice again.

The staff serving the inclusive breakfast was wonderful, she made me feel like a queen. The rooms were beautiful, felt like we were really staying in the Venetian Era - but with air conditioning as a bonus We were in good health so could walk up the 3 flights of stairs to our room but anyone with a handicap may find it difficult.
Provide better toiletries - ie conditioner
Location Bad pillows, mold in the bathroom

Location locations location , perfect location 10 min from anywhere. We were first time in Rome didn't spend much time on research and we get lucky finding something in that area is best you can get . Tons of shops and restaurants near by .There is enough room for 6-7 people. We enjoy our stay you can easy go for breaks if you get tired from city walks , perfect for family with kids . Good value for price . Old AC unit pretty loud and apartment need some floor renovation .

Location was great. Host was very nice and took extra care to make sure we were happy and had all instructions. Apartment was a good size Street out front was little noisy until late in the night. Other than that, it was great!
Locations, near the metro and lots of the attractions Washing machine, convenient kitchen Tall stairwell up Creaky bed Impurities in water AC leaking drops of water

Great central location close to attractions, shopping, restaurants. Our room had a small balcony overlooking canal and a gondola hub, which was a treat to observe from above. You can hear noise from people in unit above walking around (no voices though).

The breakfast was excellent. Good selection of food. I requested an iron and ironing board. They were in my room when I arrived. Very accommodating staff. An added bonus was the in ground swimming pool.
Exceptional settings in the country. Beautiful scenery. Quiet and clean. Pleasant hostess.
Staff were so friendly and everything was exceptional

It was perfect. From the contact before our stay to the welcome and attention to detail. My kids and I loved our stay . I am a runner and loved my morning runs. Right by the property was the nicest and safest running route!!

We loved the experience and the owners are lovely. The room (superior family room) is actually a big appartment with 2 bedrooms, a big kitchen with full size fridge and a huge balcony with a pretty view of the fields. Of course the huge pool. The area is quiet (that’s agrotiurism) and pretty. The kids had a blast with the cats (and baby cats!). Window nets to keep bugs away. Clean. Real baby bed and kid toys was good for the kids. The beds are « springy ». No air conditioning and we hit a heatwave… but I can’t complain, I knew before booking ☺️ ask them for a fan and they will gladly provide one, and with the night breeze it was doable.
The place was clearly renovated which was nice The toilet doesn’t flush, the shower head is broken, the host is unresponsive.
The location is great. Close to many cafés and restaurants.
Situated just one block off the bike path, the owner was very helpful storing the bikes and making our stay enjoyable. Nice roof deck to enjoy refreshments. Nothing
Check the comments before booking. DO NOT BOOK!!! Read the comments before booking. DO NOT BOOK!!!! This place is not safe and should not be on booking.com
It was very clean, comfortable, spacious and modern. The hosts were also incredibly nice and helpful.

Everything is very clean, the bed is super comfortable, the host is very friendly. It would be great to have air conditioning or soundproof windows, as it was difficult to open the window for fresh air when it got very noisy outside.
Very new and clean.

The breakfast was fantastic and the upgrades to the dining space are nice. The staff was very hit and missd but we had a fantastic server for both breakfast and the one dinner we did. I think his name was Mohammed and he spoke so many languages! He was very hard working and friendly with the guests. I also liked the soaps in the bathroom and the welcome drink was a nice touch. The rooms were quite cramped and we are tall so it was easy to hit or heads! It was pretty necessary to unpack as our suitcases were not very accessible. I would have also liked a chair or a table on the patio so we could take in the view.

fantastic location near Duomo - room was good - AC etc. bathroom was a bit tight, but it's Europe! bathroom was small with sink very close to toilet. many flights of stairs to get to the room but we knew about that when we booked. parking was far away but the hotel arranged a golf cart to get us to/from the hotel - I highly recommend any travelers do that.

The hosts were very welcoming and explained the details on the apartment as well guided us in what to visit in Savona. The apartment was very clean and spacious for 4 people, and we also had access to the elevator, which made it convenient for us since we stayed on the 5th floor. They provided us with many towels and all the amenities needed. We missed the details upon booking that the apartment did not have any AC. However, fans were provided in each room to help with the heat. At night, we had to keep the windows closed because of the constant noise outside. In addition, please be advised that there is an additional cleaning fee upon checking in.

A comfortable small room with fantastic window system. Several layers of closing elements (windows and shutters) provided an excellent insulation from the outside noise. An absolute silence in the middle of a busy part of the town. Good lighting, several lamps, efficient air-conditioning. A very clean bathroom in the corridor.
Very well arranged . With an inner garden which is a rarity in Venice Extremely well mannered guest ( Mr. Simone ) We will come back -

Everything! Barbara and her husband are the perfect hosts. They prepare the house with care and great attention to detail, welcome you with genuine warmth, and are truly attentive to your needs. The house itself offers everything you could possibly want or need. It’s quiet and centrally located in Tuscany. The pool is fantastic! That we had to go!
Davide and Frederica are kind and generous hosts. The facility was exceptionally clean and quiet. They went out of their way to support our stay.

The location was ok, you have to walk through a alley to get there in the night as the main gate to the hotel is closed in the night. The main gate to the hotel was closed in the night, so we had to walk through an alley to there. The alley is safe.

Amazing location, fantastic and friendly staff, clean room, and everything worked well. No big/medium complaints, had a great 5 nights! The lock is a physical key, but you can store it at the front desk. The aesthetics is not modern, but it is quite charming. No deal breakers at all. Great place to stay! Shower was small, and the room was a bit small. But we didn't spend much time in the room, so only the shower was a small inconvenience.

Very spacious & comfortable bed. The modern shower and AC were fantastic after long days in hot weather sightseeing. Check-in was easy - We were greeted and shown how to use the keys. The only thing to flag to other guests is just be aware of your surroundings returning in the evening. The location is perfect because it's close to the train station and walkable to the Coliseum, but keep in mind the kind of characters who hang around train stations (pickpockets). We didn't have anything bad happen, but we were careful. That said, once inside the building, there are three levels of security so zero worries about a break-in. I would still definitely recommend this place.
It is a quiet place. I like the location, it is 10 minutes from Venice by Tram, close to coffee shop, supermarket. the noise from neighbours at midnight for 2 days over 5 days
Really good location if you are heading on a cruise! Can fit many more people than our group of four. Can't get a better location, actually! Nothing, all good!
Wonderful location, very kind staff, great BF. A little dark room, nothing excessive, normal for the age of building.

Very well located. A short walk from Roma Termini and close to Basilica di Santa Maria Maggiore. With lots of restaurants to choose from around it and shops too. The hotel offers free breakfast and guests should be aware that the restaurant is located on another building (3 building? away) but very short walk away.

Everything was there. It really felt like a luxurious hotel because all the little details were there. The free mini bar, the coffee, the breakfast cart. The bed was really comfy and the bathroom clean and modern. Its location also made it unbeatable! Nothing!
The service, the location, the breakfast Nil
Tasty breakfast, fantastic view from terrace and room. A/c, mini fridge and jetted tub. Host was very friendly and welcoming. Secured on site parking.

The hotel and staff were amazing. The hotel was incredibly clean, the beds and bedding very comfortable and the spa/sauna was a huge bonus as well as the pool. Breakfast was excellent. Overall we loved our stay. Off the beaten track. Not directly in the Dolomites with easy access to hiking, etc. Windy, steep roads make travel more time consuming than we realized.

Eduardo, the host, is so helpful and willing to accommodate any need. The place is well equipped with a stove, fridge, coffee maker, and cookware. The bathroom also has everything you may need. The location is perfect, walking distance to main attractions and transit. The only down is that there's no A/C. The fan is good but not enough in the hot season. However, I didn't ruin the rest of the good points
The staff were fabulous as was the location. One of the rooms was very dated and needs an update. The room was very minimal.
The Hotel was very clean and upgraded. Staff was lovely and very helpful. Breakfast was wonderful. Nothing everything was wonderful.
Maria was very nice and flexible. The appartment is well equipped and the sofa-bed was comfortable!
Nice owner, convenient location, apartment with all amenities.
Simon at the front desk was awesome, the rooms were very nice , good location and breakfast was delicious
Excellent location. Quiet room.

Very clean, taken well care of, and great location with 10 min drive to the airport. Each room was secured with code system. The hotel has a great garden with lemons on the trees. The breakfast was great, and the host is a real gentleman. We forgot one of our backpacks when we checked out, he immediately sent it to the airport with a taxi, which was so great. Overall, very happy with this hotel, and will definitely stay there again once I need a place around the airport in Rome.
The appertment is very nice and big. Viviana was very kind, she answered all the questions we asked. The big bed a little inconfortable, also the pillows.
Very good breakfast, very pleasant staff, excellent location

We really enjoyed our stay at 312 Piazza San Marco. The room was clean, cozy, and beautifully decorated. Perfect location just steps from St. Mark’s Square. The staff was friendly and helpful — we felt very welcome. Highly recommended!

Surroundings in the natural parkland was unique and very quiet (although nothing around for shops or eating) Rooms were ok with comfortable beds, good bathroom, a nice balcony and a fridge Air conditioning in room (but we struggled a bit with the controls) Nice base for cycle touring and they offered secure bike storage Guests not allowed to have breakfast on the nice outdoor terrace!! Reserved for casual visitors only. We were aggressively chased off. This was a "NO GO" for us and in our view downgraded paying guests below casual visitors. Terrace was empty throughout the breakfast period (7:30-9:00) as almost no casual guests (e.g. on bikes) before 9:30. Staff didn't want to have to clean it before the casual guests started arriving. Internet was a DISASTER!! I measured download speed of 2 MB. When I showed it to the staff, they just shrugged their shoulders. I had a work video-call to do and was forced to find a hotel in the next town that allowed me to do it there. No personal present for parts of the day and in the evenings. We arrived late and had to make contact with a central number who could remotely open the main hotel door where we found our keys waiting in an envelope. It seemed staff were mostly focussed on the casual visitors for drinks and meals and less on the paying guests. Although we liked the location, we had to drive to eat somewhere or shop.
Beautiful grounds Cleanliness definitely needs improvement
Location Staff Cleanliness

The location was convenient. We stayed for three nights, but the internet was completely down for two of them. We reported it right away, but the issue wasn’t resolved promptly. There was no dish sponge, very limited toilet paper, and nothing to wipe the kitchen surfaces with. The stovetop coffee maker had no handle, making it unsafe to use. The windows had no mosquito screens, so we had to keep them closed or deal with dozens of mosquitoes at night. Check-out is early and strict, and both early check-in and luggage drop-off come with additional fees. Most of the furniture is old or in poor condition, and the windows really need replacing.

Location was excellent, staff was attentive and friendly. Room was large and comfortable. Pool and view was incredible. 10 min to Trapani, 15 to Erice and 30 min to San Vito lo capo. Road in and out confused me a bit as it was a one way out and gps kept taking me in the wrong way.

Hotel was perfectly located, and we walked to most of the local historical landmarks or took a short taxi ride which was expertly arranged by the friendly and helpful front desk staff. Breakfast was delicious and we enjoyed the quiet of the rooftop patio for evening drinks and relaxation. The elevator was a bit cramped, so we mostly used the stairs.
great place!!

It was a lovely place, spacious with a nice garden patio. The bed was comfortable and appreciated the AC as it was quite hot! Having the washer was handy to do laundry after days of travel. We got lost after all the bridges and turns in the many streets in Venice, but Iliana was very patient and helped us find our way. She was quick to respond to our quesions and a pleasure to deal with. The location was excellent once we figured out our way around -2 mintutes from Piazza San Marco! Grazie mille!

The location is perfect: close to the mosaic monuments, shopping, and restaurants, all within walking distance. The breakfast was presented beautifully with lots of selection from meats and cheeses, pastries, fruit, bacon and eggs, coffee, juice, and yogurt. It was all delicious! Just be aware that there is no elevator for people, and I believe only 1 room is on the ground floor, so as long as you are ok walking up stairs, this is a great B&B. They have a cool system set up to get your luggage upstairs for you!

Friendly staff who are willing to help and offer advice They showed us how to obtain city guest pass so we could use public transit freely including the funicular ride! The location is amazing. There is a beautiful park literally behind the hotel. With gorgeous bike /walk path Also a supermarket within short walking distance. The old town Trento within 15-20 min walk The bed wasn't comfortable. Pillows too flat. Room a bit smaller than expected.
Great location! Beds were very comfy
Very clean ,helpful staff Room was a little small
A wonderful chic property with a great breakfast
It's a perfect place in Tuscany to relax.
Room was very nice and clean Hopefully the AC has been fixed

Friendly staff and breakfast was very good, especially the home baked cakes. Must try Lemon Granita at the beach bar! The air conditioning was noisy. The food at bar was mediocre at best. But staff was very friendly and helpful.

Excellent The bed mattress was awful they have better mattress in Cuba ,the entrance at the back of the property very poor lighting and awkward steps need rail my wife fall down nowhere to hold on to, when we arrive they could have told us that the room was on the 3 floor and take the elevator instead we had to find it ourselves and drag the luggage up the 3 floor

Good distance from downtown Rome if you have a car. Free parking and breakfast buffet was nice. Breakfast was a huge spread. Didn't enjoy the pool but would stay here again for easy access to airport and the main city of having a short stay in Rome again, especially if having an early flight out next morning.
Facilities are not very clean. Cool concept for a hotel but needs more staff to keep common areas clean. Shower in bedroom had a lot of soap scum build up.
It was pleasant. Friendly staff. Would recommend.
Hosts and staff were exceptional! Property was beautiful. Would highly recommend

The room was clean and the bed and pillows were comfy. The AC worked well, and quickly. We left the AC unit powered off when we were out during the day, and only turned it on when we came back in the evenings. No issue cooling down the room pretty quickly. Towels were changed every other day, and the location is near the metro, grocery stores and lots of restaurants and cafes. Definitely would come back here if ever in Naples again. This is typical of any place we stayed at in Italy, but do not leave soap bars lying around the bathroom sink or they will be removed when the room is being cleaned. I prefer a specific soap brand because I have sensitive skin, and both here and another hotel in Rome would throw out my soap bar if I forgot to pack it away and left it in the bathroom. It wasn't expensive soap at all, and I could buy more at the grocery stores in Italy, just a hassle when I forgot to pack it away.

Enjoyed our stay. Stefano and his family are very welcoming and helpful. Quiet location with good views. Delicious breakfast trays every morning. Cute animals! Car dependant (not an issue for us just FYI). No WiFi but didn't care.

The hotel is very easy to find from the train station. The moment you are greeted at the reception, you know this will be a great vacation. Daniella is just an overall amazing person with her heart on her sleeve. She would bend backwards if she could for her guests. ''Mama'' in the kitchen is just adorable and an amazing cook. She baked a delicious cake for our anniversary. I don't know the names of all the staff but they are all smiley and are there for you. The rooms are beautiful, modern, clean, and comfortable. With a million dollar view! Don't forget to ask for beach chairs and umbrella. Nothing
Large residence, nicely located with free parking available a few steps from the property. AC was nice. They cleaned every day, nice cleaning service. Great communication with the owner.
Location The fact we had to take the garbage out or face a penalty. No new clean towels. The two cockroaches that ran across the floor. The daily loud construction going on in the building.
This property is located in a very convenient location. Erika, our host is amazing. Highly recommend this property.

Location amazing, clean, front desk individuals were inviting, and very friendly. They were quick to respond to requests if it was needing a taxi or information. Would stay in a heart beat next time in Florence again. Strongly recommend N/a ….all my travel boxes ticked for a place to stay. This is what I look for

The staff are superb! And the breakfast at the restaurant below was great. The location is perfect - not noisy and in a beautiful part of town. The air conditioning in our rooms wasn't the best. The system was really struggling to keep the room cool which made for a bit of an uncomfortable sleep. Also the washroom door is glass, so there is very little privacy when in the washroom.
It was a 5 - 7 minute walk to the beach and restaurants. A grocery store right at the corner of the hotel.

Amazing customer service from Salvatore and Concetta. Picked up at train station on arrival and then taken to train station on departure. Asked every day if we required anything, offered fresh towels whenever required. Concetta worked from an office in the same building so regularly checked in with us to ensure everything was good. The room and ensuite is perfect for a couple. Room design maximises comfort - clothes storage space in wardrobe and drawers, every kitchen amenity possible (sink, cooker, MW, fridge, bedside lighting and power points). Bed is top comfort. Ensuite bathroom appears brand new. Shower is excellent. Flooring and furnishings were modern. Location - perfect. In middle of centro historo, next to Duomo piazza and cathedral, minutes from beaches. Fantastic value for money. 🇮🇹

Our stay in Rome was wonderful. Corso Suite is very well located. We arrived early and got in touch to ask if we could leave our luggage. Within 30 minutes, Alessandra arrived and was incredibly kind and attentive. Our room was already ready, and they let us leave everything inside so we could enjoy the day. Thank you so much, and we’ll be back at the end of our trip for one more night before heading back to our country.

Easy access to airport with shuttle service provided for 5euro pp Taxi is 40euro total to piazzale roma in venice Staff was amazing , helpful with booking taxi and tours, all very friendly Nothing to complain about amazing experience overall
Amazing location. Walking distance 10mins to anywhere... Spanish steps, Piazza novena, dinner out and shopping...plus the staff super lovely. Would stay again.

The chance to experience the beauty, peace, and quiet of the Sicilian countryside. The house and gardens are charming and exquisite. Daniela, the owner, made sure that we were very comfortable; we felt very much at home.

The owners we're so helpful and amazing. The stay was so clean and immaculate didn't even need cleaners. During the week left US Food and condiments to cook Easily accessibleNo noise worth every penny thank you, andrea, and the other helpers will definitely be recommending.This place and coming back Everything was absolutely perfect

The owner was super nice and gave us a great overview of what to do in Napoli. The hotel is located right off Toledo street which has a ton of shops and food places. It's also close to the port which is convenient if you are taking the ferry to places nearby. The room itself was very spacious and clean. I would definitely stay again next time I am in Napoli!

This was the most wonderful place!!!! We had the top floor, with our own private terrace, it was incredible! We had the most amazing lady that worked there help us with everything!! She even had rose pedals in a heart on our bed as i told her it was our 20th wedding anniversary! ❤️The breakfast was so wonderful!!!! The hotel is a few mins from the vaporetto stop. I would definitely recommend this place to anyone!!! I truly hope we get to come back again!! So much love from Canada!! Nothing. It was all perfect!!!!
Excellent staff. V. Professional. V kind. Pasta in restaurant was outstanding. Gym is good. Parking infront of hotel. Clean. Had to switch rooms because of a minor thing with the bathroom.
Hosts are amazing and go above and beyond. Food is incredible. Pool is awesome.

Location is great, steps from metro. Clean and quiet place. Functional furniture could be a great improvement. Shower, toilet and bidet have issues. It feels like, besides the cleaner, no one really cares about the place. Location is great, but Price seems to be high for what it offers.

Great location right by the train station The place was clean and nicely decorated as shown in the photos The staff seemed helpful and responded quickly The building itself was weird -- it felt more like a commercial space transformed into 2 bedrooms than a proper appartment or hotel suite. There is no living room, but only a table with 4 chairs (as shown on the photos though), which is weird, especially given the fact that there isn't anything to cook. There's a microwave, but to cutlery or plates. Seemed a little bit overpriced.

Great friendly staff. Carlos couldn’t have done more to help organize transportation and ensure that our needs were tended for. The location, a stones throw from the Trevi fountain, was perfect and the breakfast was more than adequate. Very few windows and the bathroom and toilet room were small.
Clean, modern , bright room and building . Parking available
The decor, service and furnishings were excellent! No pool - and in Rome in the summer, you need it!

It's a beautiful vineyard! The view is exceptional and the staff is very friendly! The tour was also very informative and well done. The pool was a great size and well maintained. Lots of shade around the pool for those that don't like direct sunlight. Highly recommend!
Clean, comfortable, nice , location, staff
Excellent stay! Friendly staff, spotless room, and a beautiful beach view from our balcony. The beach café and pizzeria added to the great atmosphere. Highly recommend!
Really thoughtful host ! baked us a cake that was delicious !!! all really clean and comfy

Happy Home was soo lovely, clean, close to the airport and it had all the commodities we needed for a very very good price (in comparison with quality/price accommodations in the area). The room had AC, we had breakfast, lots of clean linen/towels and a tv in the room. Nino was extremely helpful and kind! He picked us up from the airport and dropped us off at the train station the next morning, he went above and beyond to make us feel comfortable and help us with our itinerary. I would strongly recommend you book with them, we definitely will stay here again anytime we come back to Fiumicino!!

- The AC was the best of all the places we stayed at in Italy - Great washrooms - Quiet non touristic area - Close to a grocery store - comfortable beds - Very nice balcony on top of the multi-level apartment - Everything was as expected. Paper towels, kitchen accessories, etc. - The balcony didn't have shade, so it gets hot quickly on a sunny summer day - While I loved how quiet the neighborhood was, it meant that we always has to walk a fair distance to take the water bus anywhere (600m), but honestly, its not as bad as it sounds. Where ever you're going, you'll need to walk anyways, so why not walk a little more.
We appreciated that after check out we could leave our luggage there for a bit for an extra fee. The staff were polite, very helpful and kind. The breakfast includes was amazing.
Right next to the airport Very small rooms
Quiet area, yet, close to attractions by foot. Kitchen well furnished. Comfortable beds. Staff welcoming and really helpful. Nothing
Vanni was available whenever we needed and responded quickly. The place was clean and had everything we needed. The location was excellent. Less than 10 minutes from the center.

Antonio is a wonderful host. He met us at the airport and even waited for 2 hours as we sorted out a lost suitcase. The apartment is really nice, and comes well stocked with coffee, breakfast items. Great location too!
Really good location, has a great breakfast. Room was large and comfortable. The bathroom was very tight and small. shower was in a bathtub and leaked on the floor when used.

Honestly, this place spoiled us for anything else. The attention to detail, fabulous decor, just an amazing renovation all in all. Loved the high ceilings and original floors. Big beds, super comfortable accommodations, and everything we needed. Simone and Ignazio were so kind and helpful, we loved them too. Great value for money, plus good location in Sciacca. We would highly recommend Domus Aleria for an extended stay while exploring nearby, as well as trying out the excellent restaurants in Sciacca. We were on the third floor and there is no lift but Simone helped with our bags on the way in and the way out. It was not a problem for us but other travellers should be aware.
Great location and very clean. Owners are wonderful and kind The stairs, lots of stairs. Very steep and hard to navigate with luggage. Only young people can navigate the stairs.

Good price / value , Friendly staff, good italien breakfast, Location is perfect for the cave (2min walk) but not in the town so really quiet , could be more decorated a bit , everything was working good and was clean but feel a bit like a hospital room without any decoration . Overall really good value I recommend if you want to travel on a budget .

The host was extremely kind and helpful. The apartment is located in the city center, with easy access to the monuments and stores. Great customer service and facility. The apartment is very beautiful and unique
Cleaning
We enjoyed the freshly baked cornettos not to mention the hot drink options. Christina was exceptionally accommodating and made us really feel at home! Nothing that I could think of

The location was amazing! The key collection can improve,i have to take the keys from Santa Margherita! Also the flat inside..the furniture is old,there is no slippers,the shower curtain is dirty,over all the money for night worth it only for the view and the location.also you have to throw your garbage by urself ,in case you forgot you will be charge with 50 euro.
All services is up to the standard and more. No More options in the breakfast menu (scrambled eggs only) though in general the level is acceptable.

The property owner was an exceptionally helpful and friendly individual. It is rare to be met with so much advice and help! We especially appreciated the thoughtful details like beach towels and ice box - the things we didn't have with us and it made a huge difference to have them available for us. We arrived late in the evening and all the free parking around the place was taken. As 3 women we didn't feel safe to look for a parking lot far away. That was the only inconvenience we experienced. Next morning we parked right at the house when people left for work and space became available.

The location was nice. It was far enough away from the bustling of crowded tourist spots, but close enough for us to hop on a scooter to get to said spots in a matter of minutes. There was a taxi lane in front of the hotel, so it was easy for us to unload and load when we checked in and checked out. The room was quiet enough at night. Sound travels very easily with the windows open, but we weren't bothered. The beds were quite comfortable, and the space was ok but inconvenient (especially when it comes to luggage). A/C worked just fine, and not sure about the TV since it stayed off for our entire stay. Front desk staff were friendly and were able to answer our questions and re-stock our room when requested. Checking-in was a hassle. The power in the building was off, and the WhatsApp chat (which we were told to join to ask questions) was non-responsive (for the whole trip actually). The Monti is on the 3rd floor, and we had about 100lbs of luggage (each) that we were carrying. We received no messaging on the booking.com app about this power disruption, so upon arrival we were flustered and in fact thought were scammed on this booking. After walking up 6 flights of stairs (2 flights per level), and using my phone light I was able to reach the front desk. As they were frustrated, so were we. I had to ask for help with luggage (no one was actively assisting people checking in); for some reason I definitely felt like this was a reasonable expectation. They had no estimation as to when the power was going to be back on, and asked us to join the WhatsApp chat for updates. After leaving the hotel for dinner, checking the chat--there were no updates to our requests. No biggie, since the power was on when we came back to the room. It was just an annoyance to be given the assurance of the responsiveness of the chat--and not hearing back. As for the room--we had 2 check-in and 2 carry-on bags with us (along with 2 backpacks), so there had to be some repositioning every time something had to be pulled out of our luggage. There was definite closet space, but not conducive to opening and closing our luggage. I had to open my luggage one at a time on my bed, whereas my friend had to open her luggage on the floor in the walkway. Just an annoyance. The WiFi was definitely below par. The reliability was intermittent, and would often be kicked off on our devices.
Accommodation, restaurant and breakfast
The location was excellent. Right on the subway and so many cafes, bars, restaurants. Extremely convenient location. Gianguido and the staff were all lovely and helpful. Enjoyed my stay.
It was extremely noisy and 2 workers walked into our room unannounced so we felt scared our stay. The bathroom had mold and there were bugs.
Breakfast was excellent. Good selection and good coffee. Room was nice and comfortable. All good.

Location is amazing, right next to Roma Termini, Staff was really genuine and offers you a program plan without even asking (no benefit for them behind it) Mathieu and Slim were extremely helpful, cheerful and nice… im definitely coming back to this hotel again. Almost nothing, maybe the fact that rooms are not fully soundproof, but this wont affect my good experience.
Close to all important sites to visit, perfect.
Very clean, very friendly. Amazing spot for tourists looking to see the sites of Rome easily by foot.

The property was in a good location. It has a lot of potential to be good. It is not. The property was not clean. The dishes and cutlery were not clean. Washing detergent, and basic cleaning utensils, and rubbish bags were not provided. Half a role of toilet paper was provided only. There were several power cuts due to overloaded electrical circuits. The floor was dirty and in need of a good clean. The dishes”shared” patio was not shared, and in fact could only be accessed through a room.
Good location, space comfortable Showers was small. No lights at entry, motion lights would be useful to prevent falls on the stairs after dusk.

Everything was great and very professional. The property is a 10-15 minute walk from the train station which was perfect for us as we took daily trips to different cities. The property had everything that we needed and communication with the owner was always fast and clear. The bed pillows were a bit too firm for my liking but I still slept fine.

We loved the hosts and their service. They were very nice people who accommodated all our needs. Not many grocery stores around, or we didn't know about them. We were with our granddaughter, and she is a picky eater.

We loved our stay at la Casa di Tamy. The apartment was super well equipped, with everything we needed for our extended stay. Located just outside the gates of San Gimignano, it is quiet but within steps of the centre. We particularly appreciated the large refrigerator, dish washer, washing machine, and beautiful views! Our host was incredibly responsive and accessible. Honestly, we loved it. The living, dining and kitchen spaces are all combined, leaving room for only one comfy chair in the living area...but as long as you're not wanting to spend time watching TV (why would you when there is so many other things to do!) it's not a problem.

The location was central and good for walking Sorrento. This room would be good for an overnight stay. The room was a little small and good for an overnight stay. It seems the apartment is divided with several rooms. We were not greeted but hosts and usually are at all the places we stay. But the check in went smoothly and nice gesture of having water in the fridge and limoncello shots. It was comfortable and safe building.

Communication with the host was great, and it turned out even better when we connected with the host's mom, who was absolutely fantastic. The place itself was nice with no complaints, and the fully stocked kitchen was a definite plus. We also appreciated the good Wi-Fi and cleanliness. A huge thank you to the host for being so accommodating and letting us temporarily store our luggage during the cleaning process before the next guests arrived; that helped us immensely! Expect some street noise at night from partygoers
excellent location with a great view. Enjoyed the terasse. the bathroom floor was wet.
Interior space is nice, very clean, and spacious. Nothing stood out as such.
Sooooo well located, really comfy too nothing

Location So much noise could not sleep had to go sleep elsewhere for a few nights just to be able to get some sleep. We asked for sort of compensation but was quickly told.no even though our neighbors got days paid and early check out by a few days and got credited. Picture of place very deceptive

It was the perfect place to settle in for a few weeks and really get to know the area. The neighborhood is stunning - in the oldest part of town. Very authentic.
