Easy access to groceries l, restaurants, bars. Super friendly staff and neighbors. Nice and quiet and very comfortable for sleeping and relaxing. Nothing - it was perfect.
Comfy enough to extend my booking way longer than expected The cosiness made it hard to leave :D

No breakfast was included. The property is very central to all tourist atractions There were not enough coat hangers. To add a full length mirror would a benefit.all overall, the stay was pleasant. The location was great.

The views were amazing, and the apartment was very nice. The staff were excellent when we did interact with them. The pool was amazing, as was the restaurant, albeit a bit pricey. The food is very good. Depending on whom is above you, you may be able to hear them walking around or moving chairs around. It's a very old building, so insulation is at a minimum. It's completely understandable.
Nice and convenient location, pleasant management and clean facilities Nothing to say

Wow. The apartment sits high above Agrigento, with stunning views of the Valley of the Temples and the sea beyond, Free secure parking is provided and the apartment easily accommodated 3 adults. The host was helpful and welcoming. The apartment was modern, clean and nicely furnished. The second bedroom was up a small flight of stairs. We declined the offer of nearby dinner reservations and instead chose to purchase food at a local store and enjoyed dinner on the outdoor patio overlooking the city. We did find the bed very uncomfortable. It felt like a single box spring without a mattress. This does not detract from our high opinion of the apartment. The basic breakfast was again enjoyed on the stunning view. We highly recommend La casa di Pippo Flora if you are visiting the Valley of the Temples. The bed was too hard for our liking.

The estate is beautiful, comfortable and nice decor. i didn't really loved the chalet style rooms, where you share a big space wit other rooms.. also not very good noise blocking. You could hear everything that was happening in the next room. the food at the restaurant could have been better

Great location in the city center, yet quiet. Warm and functional atmosphere. Very close to the underground parking. Just a few meters from great restaurant and stores. Attentive and nice host. It was all good, maybe I would just suggest putting a privacy film on the small window in the washroom.
The location was excellent, and the staff was accommodating. The room was dated, and air conditioning didn't function.
Excellent location, with a great place to stay within reataurants, markets, beach and train nearby. Great response from owners on any question marks you could have. Nothing
Pool was exactly what I needed. Food was inedible and awful. Went to the Marriott to have my dinner which was just down the road. That dinner was amazing.

The room was comfortable and the hotel was very close to a lot of restaurants and attractions. There were not a lot of amenities - they only change the singular towel every two days for example - no food, nothing like that. It isn't a very fancy place but I feel like they could have stepped it up a little bit.

Great location. Our host Mariangela took care of us. She was very helpful and made sure we were comfortable while staying in the B&B. Breakfast was good. The apartment is part of the historical building, but has been renovated. Great soundproofing, we had a good night sleep.

We stayed at the Rome Charming Suites in Rome for three nights. I enjoyed the authentic traditional aesthethic of the decor and it was quite clean. The host was very kind and accommodating. It's about a 30-40 minutes walk from the colloseum, but only minutes away from the metro. I also enjoyed the garden area. Overall, I would recommend this hotel for a stay in Rome.

The house was big and comfortable. The host was welcoming and helpful with information. It was in a convenient location, not far from parking lots to visit the town center. We were given a map with many helpful suggestions. The kitchen was not convenient. It did not have a toaster or other basic kitchen supplies. There was this big machine in the kitchen that I assumed was once a vending machine, that only took up place. Many plates were chipped, and everything was piled one on top of the other with the pot lids hidden in the oven. If that machine were removed and an addition counter-storage space put, the kitchen could be organized to be more functional. The only complaint, which I did not notice before booking, was that there is no washing machine. We were travelling with 2 young children (3 and 1) and that was a very inconvenient! We have to go to a self serve laundry, while the kids napped. We stayed at 3 other places during our 3 week vacation, and this was the only one without.

Perfect property and location. Wonderfull location with fantastic restaurants all walking distance from the agriturismo the walk up the hill to view the basilica was a little daunting. However, it was well worth the walk.
The host was super friendly, my husband and I had a great time there. We enjoyed our stay and loved the location.
clean and renovated wifi was weak
Close to train/bus station. Clean bathroom and spacious bedroom, powerful AC. Luggage storage.
Excellent service, rooms were clean and comfortable and amazing location by the ocean and walking distance to shops and restaurants🥰 Nothing
Great location near the centre of everything (train statiion, pedestrian area, restaurants). Friendly host and nice to have lift access, as the apartment is on an upper floor. All good!

Location Checking was terrible We were kept waiting till 5 pm with guaranteed checkin of 4 and then it took another 15 plus minutes. Dinner was late and by the time doors opened at 815 there was a large lineup again for no reason just bureocrazy. Warming plates were not provided for a lot of the food which meant cold food. For example cold scrambled eggs for breakfast. Other than one person staff had zero knowledge of English to the point of not being able to communicate even whether the plate has meat or not on spaghetti. Good hotel needs completely new management and staff. I have travelled to over 20 countries including other places in Italy and never experienced this poor service.
The apartment is in a stunningly beautiful location and was clean, spacious and comfortable. The host was lovely and made our stay very comfortable. Everything was great.

All of the staff were friendly. It was clean. The breakfast was included and good. 30 minutes from the centre of town. Lots of food options, pharmacy, and supermarkets around. Had a mini fridge You get what you pay for. My twin bed room was a bit cramped (smaller wardrobe and desk would make it feel larger) the desk chair was on the other side of the room as it couldn't fit under the desk because of the bed. The window was a skylight that partially opened (not something I am used to so it may just be me but I like a window I can look out) and that also made the room closed in. The shower is tiny and every moment makes the doors open. I did extend my stay got the double room and it was great. Window, bigger shower, more open so would recommend a double.

The view was beautiful Walking distance to markets and restaurants. A little hike up a hill to get there but that was part of the fun!! Caterina was a wonderful host, with quick response and very very helpful with any questions we had. Would definitely return.

A very nice place overall. I'm very surprised at how paper thin the walls are. I could make out conversations in next room and of course all the banging etc. I could hear toilets and showers. Looks so solid and the fixtures etc are tip notch. The walls seemed to amplify the rooms next to me... I have never experienced that before...

This Roman apartment is a gem! You can't beat the location directly in front of the Pantheon, with fantastic pizza and cafes right outside. It's an easy 10-12 minute walk to the Trevi Fountain and about 30 minutes to the Colosseum. What truly sets this place apart is the exceptional host, who proactively reached out via WhatsApp to ensure our comfort and support throughout our Euro trip. We'd definitely stay here again!

I have to mention the exceptional hospitality of our host Cindy. We were in a really challenging situation and Cindy went beyond "above and beyond" to help us out. Thank you so much for all your help, Cindy 🙏🏽. The apartment itself was fantastic, well located, good sized rooms, good bathrooms and kitchen. All items were provided: sheets, pillows, kitchen appliances, etc. I would highly recommend this place to anybody.
Beautiful grounds. Spacious rooms. Wonderful staff/owners. We had a wonderful meal at their restaurant. They went above and beyond. Small shower with unpleasant smell.
Great breakfast; great location to shops and restaurants We had to wheel our suitcases from the bus stop to the hotel

The rooms are delightfully appointed and comfortable with views of the marina and Ortigia just beyond. As it is just outside the main tourist areas, it is very quiet at night. The rooms have pleasant balconies with seating. There is a pleasant breakfast area and lounge shared by guests. There are restaurants close by and Ortigia is only about 8 minutes walking distance.

very little to like.it met basic needs to stay in Venice for 3 days. Beds were restful. The front door could use proper closing instead of a chain that wraps around the door knob and with a manual lock. pungent odour in prime bedroom coming from washroom...also kitchen area had foul odour not mention the flood that occurred during a torrential rain fall. furniture in living room area looked a little tired. wifi password was a puzzle to read. Lastly the remotes for the TV needed batteries, nowhere to be found. ....

The room was located close to the train station and within walking distance to everything we wanted to see. The staff (Oliver) was a fantastic host, very welcoming and helpful. There was a neighbourhood power outage, and the response by Oliver went above and beyond what we would expect at pretty much anyplace else. Thanks, Oliver! If we are in Rome again we will def stay there! Not applicable.
breakfast was OK nothing super. More choices of juices and hearlty itemsD

The location is great that its close to the metro and the bus stations. The staff is absolutely amazing. They have always been responsive and very nice. They have really good amenties and the room is amazing. The check in and check out is has been really smooth. I would recomment it 100%. Would go back here in a heartbeat.

The room was amazing and even had a rooftop terrase accessible directly from a stair located in the room. It had a small fridge and all the equipment required. The bed was very comfortable and the hotel was located at a decent 15 minutes walk from the old part of the city. There is no parking onsite, the closest available option was at about 800meters which is not that bad if you plan to stay for a couple of nights. The fridge was not that cold and so was the AC. Besides that it was awesome.
Excellent decor. Clean and comfortable. No breakfast. No water in the room.

Decent for short stay, walkable in the Fiumicino area. Place was clean and tidy, and breakfast was provided. Although it was close to the airport, it was still a 10 min drive, and costed 30 euros by taxi to get there. Did not have any hand soap, messaged property manager but no response. Early checkout (10am), and was not able to accommodate a later checkout even for 11am.

Lovely restaurant for breakfast. Buffet with lots of choices of cold items both sweet and savoury. Great cappuccino. Modern decor with glass staircase and elevator. Very clean. Comfortable bed, nice view of the piazza from our window. Good location about 10 minute walk to train station but close to restaurants. Room on the small side and no place to hang clothes.

Felt like we were in a movie! Or on a ship! Those views!! The Terme, pool and Spa are lovely. The staff, especially Rosanna, were very welcoming and helpful. The lighting in the lobby, bar and restaurant was full on LED. Could be greatly improved by changing it to more atmospheric lighting.

We had no idea what to expect of the area, but loved it. Close to larger centres, but close to vineyards and many historic sites. The accommodation was excellent. Breakfasts, excellent. We will recommend to friends. We liked it all. No complaints. Staff was very helpful and if we were out about, places were easy to find.
The property was easy to locate as Loris gave detailed directions from the train station. The property was well located with a clean & comfortable room.

The shower box was clogged ( old problem, considering the raised level of the vinyl floor in the washroom and the spots of water on the door. Almost the entire room was invaded by the water within a couple of minutes. Just one of us was able to shower, and our luggage and its contents were soaked. The solution was to dry the copious amount of water with a rag and offer to change the room. Of course, they knew we were about to check out. Offer made just for the sake of. See above

It was clean, the host was nice, helped us with any information and was punctual with communication. The air conditioning was not working and it was very hot in the room. There was an old and moldy smell in the room.

Small family business, the entire family works on the premises and is doing their best to keep it running as smoothly as possible. Location of lower apartments just a couple meters from the beach. Communication- the lack of it cost us almost 2 hours extra waiting at Lamezia Airport for the car/taxi we pre-arranged/ booked in advance. Plus, after that unfortunate wait in excruciating heat we got a shuttle shared with another couple buy we were still charged full price of Eur70 as we would get an individual transfer. Also communication problem caused unpleasant payment related issue at check-out. Luckily it was finally solved.
Great location. Very clean. Host is very helpfull. Although it’s ok, air conditioning is not the best when it’s very hot outside.

Before we came, our main worry is, without reception desk, how convenient to reach the property manager when in site. The quick response in messaging before we got to Rome released our worry. The surprising smoothness of our check-in amazed us. The comfortableness of the newly renovated room surprised us as well. The location is super good, in a safe area with nice residences around, near bus stops and city center. There is even a nice super market in the same building.
Great breakfast, Great staff. The view was amazing. The pool was very good and was deep. I hope to go back and stay here again in the future. The parking was very good and very easy.
Location was perfect, in the heart of Rome. The person at the reception was very helpful and nice.

The perfect base from which to explore Cinque Terre. The location is incredible. Located right at the start of the path to Carniglia. The views from the room are absolutely stunning. The room was comfortable, clean, and spacious. The balcony overlooking Vernazza and the water are the cherry on the cake. Communication with the host was smooth and easy. Check-in was a breeze. We even received a little video showing us how to find the room from the train station. 100% recommended for your trip to Cinque Terre. Staying in Vernazza means you get to enjoy the most beautiful town after the tourists have left. :)
Buffet was excellent U would have liked a beach with sand. However, it’s on the rocks. Thats how puglia is.

The Breakfast was extravagant with lots of variety, fresh fruits, variety of fresh croisants, breads, yogurts, meats and cheese. You could order your eggs fresh in 3 ways, with bacon. Coffees were also individually made, all in an elegant Belle Epoque decor, with chandeliers and mirrors and lots of windows looking out over the ferry landing. The welcoming Concierge was cheerful and happy to help with my luggage going up a cobblestone Hill in a separate building. My room was brand new renovated with gorgeous views of the Lake Como Harbor. Wine, bottled water and Prosecco was in a small fridge. The Staff at the Hotel was very welcoming and warm-hearted. I loved my Stay of 3 nights at this Hotel in Varenna. Make sure you book the restaurant for evening meals well in advance as it’s wonderful.
Nice. Very calm. Nice to jump in the pool after a day in Siena

The location was very central to be able to walk in town. The room was clean. If you are travelling by car, there is no easy way to park, unload/load. Also parking can be many blocks away, and while not expensive, it still is an added expense. Booking.com website said the rooms have a view. Not ours! Cement walls to look at. The site also said breakfast included, but didn’t expand to say it was yogurt and milk in the fridge with crackers and cookies in packets. Not at all what we were expecting. The neighborhood has renovations happening which just adds to the stress of car maneuvers!

Very nice apartment. Clean, comfortable, and well equipped. Sandra is an outstanding host. She greeted us in person, provided lots of info and great suggestions for activities and transportation. I definitely recommend it. Minor detail, but an upgrade in towels and pillows would be nice.
Beautiful unique building, amazing amenities, wonderful meals. Staff were very friendly and helpful.

Host was friendly and welcoming. Room was fresh and modern, it looks like it was recently renovated, which made it feel even nicer. Stylish bathroom. Thick window blinds. Breakfast was tasty with great coffee, they even provided gluten-free options. Location was also very convenient. Room was very small, beds could have been bigger and more comfortable

We were so glad to have found this hotel — the view was incredible, the bed very comfortable, everything spotless, and the breakfast just perfect. The highlight of our stay was Cristiana, our host, who took such great care of us. Thank you!

This farmstead is a true gem; I feel very fortunate to have experienced it. It offers a unique stay that surpasses many five-star hotels. The location is ideal—just 20 minutes from the airport in a peaceful rural area—making it a perfect base for exploring the southern coast of Sardinia. The room was exceptionally clean and tranquil, enhanced by the natural aroma of wood, a very comfortable bed, and quiet air-conditioning that ensures restful sleep. The hosts are welcoming, helpful, and highly knowledgeable. I recommend asking Marko for suggestions on local activities and attractions. Additionally, be sure to participate in the olive oil tour to learn about the production process firsthand. The breakfast was outstanding—healthy, homemade, delicious, and offering a wide variety of options. I look forward to returning and reconnecting with my new friends in Sardinia. Thank you for a memorable and enjoyable experience. Absolutely nothing.

The staff were very helpful and supported all our needs The free shuttle was amazing for getting to Florence in the morning There is a bus stop right in front of the hotel for cheap transportation. The hotel is close to Fiesole and good restaurants 3 Stairs to get to bed from bathroom This wasn't a problem for us but it could be for others

Extremely well located. Staff are helpful but not 247 like most hotels. Shower was broken but working. Bed was comfy, room cleaned and very spacious. Shower was broken we didn't bother saying anything as I looked up on google and saw other people complaining regarding the same problem...
Very spacious, clean, contains amenities, and convenient location

The owner was very helpful and made the stay a great experience. The accommodation was perfect for our family. Walking distance to shops, beach and restaurants. Sitting in the third floor and accessible via the stairs is to mention.
The staff were very friendly and helpful. Window had ocean view.

This is our 2nd time back we love this hotel ! Rooms are so big lots space. Views are fabulous. The breakfast is great. The people who run the hotel treat us like friends are visiting. ♥️ No comment we ❤️ this hotel.
Keys were difficult to open and close the doors Breakfast and water and juice was sufficient Negotiated flat 25 Euro taxi charge was appreciated
Athena was a great host she explained everything super well, absolutely lovely, would recommend to everyone plus close to the Vatican.
The large room It was not clean and the beds were uncomfortable, no AC, lots of noise til after midnight

This hotel was fantastic, from the quaint setting, the excellent breakfast, and the perfect amenities - I would race back here to stay longer! If you want to be in town, know that it isn't - but there's a bus stop out front, free transit, parking, and a cute pathway down to town!
Great location

It was wonderful to have the breakfast included. Our rooms were not ready when we first arrived but it didn’t take long and they allowed us to sit and wait in the lobby until they were ready . The staff at the front desk were pleasant and helpful. They called cabs for us it was easy to walk nearby and find a restaurant.
Excellent service, communication and location. Please was also really nice. I would definitely return.

location was amazing and host was incredibly helpful the furniture is very tired and AC in the master bedroom doesn't work well. More towels and a few facecloths would have been useful. It was great having a washer!
Position of the unit and communication with the owner, very nice and helpful! Small room
Mr Ron is very helpful and acommodating
Great location in Portoscuso near restaurants by foot. Mixed room and Angela and her husband were great hosts...very helpful and friendly.
Very good breakfast!
Everything exceeded my expectations, a short team from downtown

The location was amazing! All the stairs were not clearly disclosed, I knew there was one flight to get into the apartment and a flight of stairs to get to the loft sleeping area, but there is still a steep wooden set and a spiral staircase to get into the apartment. If you have large suitcases it is not very fun getting them up the stairs! The stairs are very steep and in my opinion a bit sketchy. The shower was sooooo small that we could barely fit through the opening! The sofa bed would not be comfortable for more than one person as one of the sides is incredibly hard and uncomfortable.

Nice and clean room with balcony with great view. Rooms are quiet and kind owner I don’t appreciate when as guests, we need to ask for water in the rooms and pay for it. This should be included in the (not so cheap) total price we pay and even more so that we are in the middle of June in Ischia and it’s extremely hot… I was also not offered any breakfast, only dry toast crackers and a sealed cube of butter and a coffee. I booked this place thinking breakfast would be included but that was not what I thought it would be based on the description… also no AC in room
We picked it because it was close to the airport and provided a shuttle bus. It was expensive and should have included breakfast and free shuttle.

The location was good for our purpose. We wanted a place, where kids would sleep in a separate room (it was a bunkbed for them) and with free parking. The garden view room doesn't have any view and also there were lots of mosquitos outside and inside the room. The room has provided fumigator tablets, they helped, but just a little.

The location was great and the host was easy to reach. She was very kind to let us leave our baggage on the premises before check in. The washroom was dated with lots of mildew. The towels all had a strong smell of vinegar. It is very noisy as you can hear folks talking in the next rooms. The rooms itself was dated and just clean enough. The cost was rather high for what you get, as we have stayed in cleaner, more modern, quieter accommodations in the same area for much less.
Friendly and attentive host. Clean and spacious apartment and great location. Nothing
Everything about the hotel was super amazing Newly refurbished Brand new facilities Very neat and clean Location 30-35 mins from the City Center

We had a nice stay at Hotel Montreal. The location is excellent—right next to the train station and just a short walk to the city center. Our room was bright, clean, with a working AC and enough space for our needs. The 24-hour reception was a plus, and we appreciated having an elevator to reach our floor.
Great view, close to town, quiet, nice hosts, very clean. Don't let the exterior put you off its very nice inside.

Reception, concierge and dining room staff all really helpful and nice. Nice little nibbles platter when you order drinks. Setting and interior gorgeous. There were shutters in my room but one of the massive windows did not have shutters, nor proper curtains, so you will get woken up super early by lots of strong light. The airconditioning could not handle the heat and it was too warm in the bedroom. The pool and happy hour were seriously over crowded. Hôtel only has 50 rooms but I suspect they sell extra spaces - too many- to people from outside. Tea bags in your room but no kettle so you need to use the hot water from the coffee machine resulting in tea tasting of watery coffee. When you come for happy hour and they hand you your drink they mark it on a paper wristband - you need to be wearing- felt a bit ‘cheap’ for a 5 star hotel.

An amazing historical house in a quiet part of the city, not far from the centre. Nice garden, private parking and easy access with a key app. Comfortable bed. The room had a few issues: the air conditioning wall unit had a rattling fan and was so noisy that we couldn’t keep it on at night. In the bathroom the sink drain was blocked and the water did not pass well.
Great location and service. Simone was wonderful during breakfast service. Reception was friendly and welcoming. It was all good.
Very attentive hosts, accommodating, excellent starting point for many interesting day trips. No air conditioning.
Everything was perfect, especially the breakfast, it was delicious as it was the shower room, and all the services and the people working here friendly
Location was perfect, close to the train station and Via Sparano. Washroom was practical but cramped.

Ended up staying at Villa Adelaide mainly because it was a central location to Ostuni, Alberobello and Monopoli for day trips. The pool was a nice treat after running around all day. What we didn't expect or even know anything about was what a fantastic little town Ceglie Messapica turned out to be. We found ourselves down at the Piazza every night for a bite to eat and enjoy the sights and sounds of this cool village. Great bars and restaurants and super friendly people. Nothing

The location was incredible. Close to everything important to us. The breakfast was delicious, the rooms were clean, there was a lift. The terrace was beautiful. Can't think of anything we didn't like!
Everyone loved the pool
It was very clean and spacious. The hosts went above and beyond to accommodate us. Everything was perfect.

It felt like home the room.has a perfect size and location. The decor was very fresh and simple. The best was Alessandro he was great he assisted us for the 3 days we stayed , and we will stay there again on our next trip for sure My only comment is that the bathroom window needs a heavier curtain for privacy

Our room was spacious and bright, with a view out to the sea from the west window and a very large terrace off of glass doors on the south side. The hotel is in an 18th century villa, with extensive grounds, worthy of a stroll. The breakfast buffet is included with the room and has quite a good selection of items. You can sit indoors or outside in the courtyard, and it's a nice start to the day. The location is a short walk to the excavation site and to shops and restaurants. We ended up with an unallocated day, so spent several hours in the courtyard reading or at the pool, swimming, reading and just having a "down day" and enjoying the ambience and amenities of the hotel. I would recommend staying here to anyone visiting the area. We were originally planning on taking the train from Pompeii to visit the excavation, but I spotted this hotel, and wanted to stay here, so we split our accommodation between Pompeii and Ercolano. It was worth relocating for, and a walkable distance from the train station. The air conditioning in our room did not work properly, and the temperature was mid-30s. Staff were helpful in setting up a portable air conditioner, but it did not last the night, so our sleeps were not as good as if we'd had air conditioning, or the weather had been cooler. I don't imagine this is an ongoing issue, though.

The room was spacious, clean, and cozy. The staff was very useful. The location was great. To access the “private beach” of the hotel you must pay 25 euros per day. We were told to leave as we didn’t pay. 20 euros parking. A lot of the advertised amenities in the pictures are inaccessible without paying a 20+ euros fees.

Great little spot. We had a room overlooking the canal, which was special. We could see the grand canal in the distance. The hotel was clean and nice. One staff person was super friendly, but a rather crusty woman was there the day ws left. She seemed annoyed to have to interact with us. The location is excellent! 3rd stop on the water bus from the hotel. I would recommend this place for a clean, central place right on the canal.

Great location near the mountains and beautiful towns. Very relaxing stay @ the end of a month long trip. Refreshing sparkling infinite pool. Loved the owners' dogs. Beautiful setting @ breakfast under the trees. Unfortunately we weren't able to have dinner @ the property.
Very clean and renovated. Breakfast was very basic but good.

location is great, short drive to stores and small beautiful historic towns. The grounds and the facilities are beautiful, well maintained and clean. The pool is amazing! Breakfast was ones of the best we ever had, and an experience in itself! Coffee and the fresh food and baked goods were the best! the pillows and the mattresses were a bit uncomfortable so maybe a topper and better quality pillows would be a plus.
Good location, big appartement and confortable beds AC not working well

Well maintained premises; beautiful comfortable room in a garden environment. Was very well received by the late afternoon staff. Morning breakfast had many varied offerings and was served by friendly staff. May I suggest paving stones at the edge of the gravel drive. This path would facilitate the rolling of a suitcase from the gate to reception.

Positive highlighta: very friendly staff, cleanliness, location (close to train station) . Cbb: shower had very weak "flow"...if for water economy you will have to spend a bit more time to wash yourself. The sink had stronger debit Breakfast: may i politely suggest, you could add some music or ambiance to the room so it doesn't fell so much as a "private" room. But the waitress was very kind. The blankets are very thin so to feel confortable i believe yoy have to raise temperature of the riom to get confortable. This could be good or bad for different people

Fantastic location - easy walk from the main train station and then to all the attractions within a 20 minute radius. The room was huge (for three of us) and clean. The building is very unique, with a combination of elevator and stairs, so tough if you have difficulties carrying heavy suitcases, but the staff are more than willing to assist. Front desk staff exceptional, especially "Annika". Also, a very good included breakfast to get the day started right! And 24hr access to coffee or juice machine with a nice outdoor veranda for the evening. Like many European hotels, we experienced clogged drains in the sinks and showers, which made being aware of water backing up a necessity. Our shower was nice, but the water drained out onto the bathroom floor, so always had to mop it up with extra towels.
Great location. Very stylish rooms.Amazing staff!Very good breakfast.Parking is well organized for the guests Would definitely recommend these place!!!

Located within comfortable walking distance to the cruise pier; practically at the bus stop for convenient busses to, for example, Castel Miramare and Prosecco. Very spacious; impeccably clean, well equipped. Can't think of anything.
Everything.

Location was great and just outside of the tourist bubble. The roof patio alone was worth it. Big condo with multiple floors. Bed and couch bed were also comfortable. Condo was clean and recently renovated. Only thing missing was an ice cube tray. Which is obviously nothing to complain about.
Everything was fantastic.. just bathrooms should have been 2 instead of 1. Rest everything was fantastic

We thoroughly enjoyed our stay. The location is excellent—just a short walk from the metro station and surrounded by shops, stores, and restaurants. We had two rooms next to each other, both very quiet and comfortable. It’s clear that the owner has thoughtfully considered the needs of travelers. We especially appreciated the cold drinks, snacks, and the espresso machine in the kitchen. Virginia also provided many helpful suggestions for tours and restaurants, which made it much easier for us to explore and enjoy the city. Overall, the hotel exceeded our expectations. None

Unassuming for sure, but very comfortable and an excellent breakfast.
A gem of a hotel.. staff was 💯. Location was perfect for our cruise destination. You will not be disappointed. Clean, clean, clean ..and the staff very friendly and knowledgeable. Perfect stay!

Highly recommend. The location is incredible. Rome is on your doorstep. The building is attached to an old monastery and church. There's wonderful religious art in the stairwell. Marina is generously accommodating with breakfast times. We had early tours every day. She made sure we were fed before we left. We all enjoyed breakfast which included fresh croissants and Nespresso coffee in a comfortable room with assigned seating. The AC in our room worked incredibly well. Room has an ideal layout for a family of 4 with 2 separate twin beds in one room and a king size bed in the other. The shower is tiny and the shower head in need of repair. 74 steps to get to your room. Not a problem for us, but good to be aware.

This is the best place I’ve stayed at in all of Europe. Loredana and her family were such kind, warm and helpful hosts. She went out of her way to help me with everything. Taormina is a beautiful town that looks like a movie, and this suite is exactly that. It is newly renovated, the bed is extremely comfy and the windows are sound proof. You are located right on the Main Street but as soon as you close the windows you wouldn’t know it. It has a balcony that you can sit out on. Honestly the best place I’ve stayed, the town is absolutely stunning and the hosts are the most kindest people. Will definitely be going back to Sicily and definitely staying here.

Really beautiful hotel with lots of character and gracious staff. Loved everything about my stay there. Perfect location. The bed was two single beds stuck together with a crack down the middle haha. Not a big deal.
This was my second time staying at Villa Grazianella. Exceptional service, location, and the staff is always so nice and sweet. I will definitely be coming back again! Nothing!

The apartment is well located, close to the metro, the Coliseum and a grocery store. However, the apartment is not well maintained. The faucet leaks from 4 sides, the pan drawer was very dirty, there were no utensils in the kitchen... in short, I was glad I wasn't there for more than 3 nights.

Perfect stay! The apartment was spotless, well-equipped, and ideally located. It was comfortable and quiet. A special mention to Annalisa, the owner, who was exceptionally kind and helpful, always ready to assist and share great tips. We immediately felt at home. Highly recommended!

Location was great. Sadly the stairs were far more than my 82 year old knees could take. We decided to leave after the first night. Also, the handrail on the stairs ended before the top of the staircase, which is quite dangerous for older people.

We were pleasantly pleased with our experience at blurooms,it was in the perfect location ,but still quiet at night for sleep,the restaurant underneath posed no issues,in fact food was delicious and good prices.The room was very clean,staff were friendly and accommodating,we would recommend this place for a great visit to sorrento.

The room, location, staff, and cost were excellent. Marjan was incredibly responsive, kind, and helpful during our stay. Our room, the Carolina, was well-furnished, spacious, and comfortable. Cleanliness and attention to detail with respect to room maintenance was great, as well. There were additional fees we had to pay on the premises due to Rome's short-term accommodations legislation. This is no problem, in and of itself, and they weren't a lot (4 euro per guest per day, or so), but it would be better to have those fees transparent up front on the total cost, instead of the guest having to find out on the spot. The staff handled it well, but it would just be better to know up front.

Dino was such an AMAZING host!! He treated everyone like family. He has a wealth of knowledge and information and will make you laugh until you have stitches in your side. He is very accommodating,and absolutely a pleasure to be around. He told us about the area and what to see and when the best times were to see things. We will be going back. Thx Dino for the memories!

Clean place for decent price. Two bathrooms is awesome. The beds were SO uncomfortable. It felt like sleeping on a box spring. It was really cold and the blankets are limited. I was not impressed I had to drive 15 minutes to a hotel to get the keys. This was not explained until after booking. No wifi. Quiet hours were too early/late.

The hostess is very kind and has thought about all amenities possible to make her home comfortable for all her guests. The fridge and kitcken came fully stocked, milk, cookies, almond milk, cheese, bread, wine, snacks, eggs and lots more. The apartment is stunning, great for families and the area couldnt be better. A MUST STAY for those that visit Catania. Grazie

Location Having a lift Good staff Clean I liked that you could rent a padlock to fit, not have to buy Room was Air conditioned, but the shower was not, so easy to get sweaty again almost immediately Common downstairs area was nice but not air conditioned and therefore not that comfortable
Location Spacious Cleansiness AC
Breakfast was exceptional at a restaurant down the street. The staff treated us like gold and the coffee and coronetto were very good.

Everyone in the hotel was kind and friendly and always with a smile. We felt like family. Buffet style breakfast was delicious. Many options for N. American and Europeans.Three hot options like scrambled egg and sausage as well as a waffle machine. Deli meats and cheeses and numerous breads and jams and many sweets and beverage choices along with fruit options, yogurt and cereals. Concierge services were excellent, including detailed information about various options on how to get to the hotel. Jacobo went above and beyond expectations to help us with bookings, information about transportation to and from Hotel and around the city and providing accessories we had accidentally forgotten. The gym had enough essential equipment with a small pool for a very reasonable price to enter per day (5€). Location was phenomenal! A 5 min walk to San Marco's piazza. All over Italy, including Venice there are no screens on windows, so keep your windows closed to keep out mosquitoes.

Central location, helpful staff - I could keep my luggage before check in in nearby shop, kitchen, fridge. God budget option for a solo traveler There is confusion in the address - the B&B is not on 17 Vicolo but on 17 Via Prigioni.
Excellent breakfast. Walking distance to the beach, Cinque Terre National trailhead and the old town.

The staff was very friendly and helpful. The breakfast was really good with a variety of choices and our room was very clean and comfy. There's lots of restaurants around and the train station across.

My mother and I visited Venice and stayed at Ca’ Cappellis from June 9th to 15th, 2025, to celebrate her 77th birthday. We stayed in the King Suite on the 2nd floor—52 stairs up (there is no elevator). Thankfully, the host kindly helped my mother with her suitcase, which was greatly appreciated. The building had a charming Venetian feel with a grand door and security cameras. As two women traveling alone, we felt very safe in the area—and throughout Venice. The suite was amazing—very large with 20-foot ceilings, beautiful decor, and a spacious, modern bathroom with a walk-in shower. The bed was very comfortable, and the whole space felt clean and luxurious. It was extremely hot, so the air conditioning was a lifesaver. There was a TV (we didn’t use it) and a window with a charming street view. The bathroom was well-stocked with slippers, toothbrushes, toothpaste, vanity kits, shampoo, and soap. There was also a bidet—though we didn’t use it. Two bottles of water were in the fridge, along with a coffee and tea station. There’s a shared lounge area, though we didn’t use it. Before arrival, we received a helpful WhatsApp message from the host with buzzer code info, where to find the key, and directions from the airport—right down to the boat line and company to take. This made navigating much easier. The host was extremely friendly, suggested a nearby place for dinner on our first night, and helped us get our bearings using a map the next day. That small gesture really helped us feel more confident exploring the city. The beginning of our stay felt like royal treatment. Ca’ Cappellis is in a fantastic location. We absolutely loved our time in Venice and will definitely return! There are a few areas where improvements could elevate the guest experience to exceptional. 1. Two rolls of toilet paper were provided on the first day, and they were never replenished—we ended up having to buy our own. 2. The tissue box was already more than half used and wasn’t replaced. 3. Coffee pods and tea were supplied initially, but by end week we were down to one pod and three tea bags. 4. The two cookies offered on the first day were never replaced, nor were the two bottles of water in the fridge. (Not sure if they were meant to be replaced but would have been nice) 5. We paid for the breakfast cart (appx $30 Cdn/day). It started off beautifully—full, fresh, and made us feel like royalty. But by midweek, it noticeably declined. Bottled water was only included the first two days. I requested apple juice and received it once, but then all juice disappeared. Two cereals became one. By the last day, we were disappointed as we paid extra for this service. 6. Guest soap was never replaced. On the last day, three mini shampoo bottles were added—but all had broken seals and were half used. 7. One of the bathroom sink had a leaking faucet and the sink drained slowly. I wrapped a towel around it so I didn't use it as water would leak onto the toilet paper and down on the floor. I did bring this issue up to the host and she said she would have a plumber look at it. 8. This is just a suggestion - maybe add a logo notepad or logo paper in the welcome folder. We needed paper and hadn’t thought to bring any. The host did provide us with a pen to use, which was very helpful. 9. The host was present every day—except checkout day. We weren’t given instructions on check out, so we just left the keys in the door. Hopefully that was the right thing to do. I think these issues can be resolved by making sure the staff stay consistent and restock everything in the rooms. *Overall we had an an amazing experience, these things would have made our stay exceptional.*

The owner is super friendly and very knowledgeable about Milano. Definitely, a hidden gem near Udine station (only 5 min walk) on Metro Line 2, Green Line, hence the name Linea Verde. Very accommodating with my breakfast time as I had to leave quite early in the morning. Nothing I can think about
Great location. Close to downtown Trieste shower enclosure partitions not easy to operate, double bed mattress is two mattresses against each other.
The breakfast was great!
Convenient location on walking street, close to metro, next to Vatican, a lot of shops and restaurants, clean, comfortable beds. One very nice restaurant is downstairs: OSTERIA FARUSO. All was good

This hotel is Top Notch in every way. The location is very close to historic Taormina and yet removed just enough from the noisy Center to make it very quiet at night and very convenient for walking to the Center of town. Our view from the 5th floor Terrace was spectacular. The room was smallish by Canadian standards, but good size by Italian standards, and very adequate for a five night stay, very clean and had all necessary amenities. The infinity pool on the second floor of the hotel is beautiful, and it has an amazing view of the Strait of Messina . The service was very professional and Perfect by all staff members. A few names are worth mentioning. At the front desk Francesco, Rosario and Ivana did everything necessary to make our stay at the hotel perfect. In the restaurant Andra, Nancy, Thomas, and Nino, the chef, made sure that we had everything we needed, including personalized menu for me and my wife when we made requests for food that was not on the menu. This is amazing service and is worth mentioning on this review. The cleaning lady, whose name I cannot recall, was very accommodating, and easily agreed to any request that we made regarding the cleaning of the room, and the amenities in it. Overall, I would rate Splendid Hotel Taormina as a top-notch outstanding hotel that I would recommend to anybody who is traveling to Taormina. There is nothing not to like about this hotel.

Beautiful, spacious apartment. Good communication. Accommodating hosts. We had a lovely stay, and I would definitely book this space again. Some of the pictures suggest a better view of the river. You can't really see the water from the balcony, but you get a good view of the Ponte Vecchio.
Everything about this place was amazing. Nothing indeed.
Perfect location to visit Tropea on foot, modern room with a nice view. Ideal for relaxing after a day around Tropea

The place itself is new, comfortable, and offers great space — I really enjoyed the physical environment. The washing machine and heated rack was great! However, the communication for customer service is unreliable, which made the stay frustrating at times. You can feel helpless when you have questions, as they don’t respond promptly and don’t seem to keep up with their 24/7 promise of a virtual reception. With better responsiveness, this could be an excellent stay.
Location was great The stairs to get to the third floor. I thought it was 2nd.

Nice room, clean, and quiet; stayed for a night before my flight. It can be hard to reach this location - taxis are very expensive; my advice would be to take the Cotral bus (its goes towards Ostia) from the airport, it comes once every hour and there's a stop (on via scafa) just at the end of the street making it a ~12 min walk to the house. This can be quite a hassle, the first time but saves a lot of money.
Due to a little detail we changed our location, the hosts were very proactive in offering another place nearby that was perfect to us.

Fabulous location, spacious apartment, well equipped kitchen, washing machine, clothes line & iron. Lots of closet and drawer space, bright but you could close interior shutters for darkness. Wi-Fi was slow and would cut out, stairs are very very steep
